articleTitle: A Novel SiC Trench MOSFET with Unilateral P Buried Layer for Improved Oxide Electric Field and Switching Loss
publicationTitle: 2023 20th China International Forum on Solid State Lighting & 2023 9th International Forum on Wide Bandgap Semiconductors (SSLCHINA: IFWS)
abstract: A novel SiC trench MOSFET with unilateral P buried layer (SiC UP-MOS) for improved oxide electric field and switching loss is proposed and characterized in this paper. Compared with SiC asymmetric trench MOSFET (AT-MOS), the UP-MOS exhibits the lower ON-resistance (R<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">on</inf>) and third quadrant ON-state voltage drop (V<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">on</inf>) due to the higher channel density and the integrated Schottky barrier diode. Benefited from the grounded unilateral P buried layer, UP- MOS achieves a more excellent tradeoff between the R<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">on</inf> and the maximum gate oxide electric field (E<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">ox,max</inf>) than AT-MOS. Moreover, thanks to the smaller overlaps of gate to drain, the UP-MOS shows a lower transfer capacitance (C<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">gd</inf>), thus the turn-off and turn-on loss of UP-MOS is 65.7% lower and 48.9% lower than those of AT-MOS, respectively. Considering the conduction and switching capability, the high-frequency figure of merit (HFFOM, i.e., R<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">on</inf>×C<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">gd</inf>) for UP-MOS is improved by 4.4 times compared with AT-MOS. The performance improvements indicate that the SiC UP-MOS is a competitive candidate for high-voltage and high-frequency applications.

articleTitle: Total Ionizing Dose Radiation Effect on Avalanche Robustness of 1200V Trench-type SiC Power MOSFETs
publicationTitle: 2023 20th China International Forum on Solid State Lighting & 2023 9th International Forum on Wide Bandgap Semiconductors (SSLCHINA: IFWS)
abstract: SiC power MOSFETs have been widely adopted in EVs, and increasingly gaining attentions from aerospace applications recently. However, radiation-related problems are still of great concerns before mass adoption in aerospace industries. In this paper, we investigated the total ionizing radiation (TID) effect on avalanche robustness of 1200V SiC power MOSFETs with symmetric trench gate structure. It is experimentally observed that the failure mechanism does not change, but both avalanche current and avalanche energy are significantly reduced after 100krad TID radiation. For example, the avalanche current and avalanche energy of SiC MOSFETs after 100krad radiation under V<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">GS</inf> = 15V bias reduced by 3.9A (35.9%) and 80.2mJ (58.9%) by unclamped inductive switching test under 100V bus voltage and 5mH inductive load. Obviously, the avalanche robustness of SiC MOSFETs is greatly affected by TID radiation and proper harden methods are essential to avoid significant degradation in robustness of SiC MOSFETs before mass adoption into aerospace applications.

articleTitle: Demonstration of a 1200V Periodic Full-P Encapsulated 4H-SiC Trench MOSFET
publicationTitle: 2023 20th China International Forum on Solid State Lighting & 2023 9th International Forum on Wide Bandgap Semiconductors (SSLCHINA: IFWS)
abstract: In this study, we have designed and fabricated a novel 1200 V periodic full-P encapsulated 4H-SiC trench MOSFET. The proposed SiC trench MOSFET substantially alleviates the tradeoff dilemma between breakdown characteristic and specific on-resistance, resulting in a larger design window that simultaneously achieves effective breakdown voltage, lower gate oxide layer electric field, and excellent on-state characteristics. Through numerical simulation and analysis, the design considerations and device performance of the proposed SiC trench MOSFET are demonstrated. The results show that the breakdown voltage of the proposed structure reaches 1675 V. When V<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">DS</inf> = 1200 V, the electric field of the gate oxide layer is only 1.2 MV/cm. The periodic P+ buried layer encapsulated structure and the P-shield region at the bottom of the trench together form a good protection for the gate. At the same time, the most important N-Enrich region of the device is further optimized. It is concluded that when the width is 2 μm and the concentration is 1.0×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">17</sup> cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-3</sup>, the specific on-resistance is only 3.0 mΩ·cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>. The BFOM is as high as 935 MW/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>. The proposed structure greatly improves the compromise between breakdown characteristics and specific on-resistance. Moreover, first demonstration of the periodic full-P encapsulated SiC trench MOSFET prototype fabrication and SEM of two different cross sections are also detailed in this study.

articleTitle: Effect of Coloured Text and Background Combination on Visual Comfort for Reading on Display
publicationTitle: 2023 20th China International Forum on Solid State Lighting & 2023 9th International Forum on Wide Bandgap Semiconductors (SSLCHINA: IFWS)
abstract: A psychophysical experiment was conducted to investigate visual comfort on displays. 107 images of coloured text on neutral backgrounds were assessed by 20 observers using a magnitude estimation method. The ambient lighting was set at an illuminance of 500 lx and a CCT of 6500 K. The results indicated that reading coloured text on a black background exhibited higher levels of visual comfort compared to that of a white background. In addition, smaller colour differences between the text and background resulted in reduction of visual comfort, while no significant effect of the hue of text was observed. Overall, the present results of provide valuable information on how to improve visual comfort when reading coloured text on mobile displays.

articleTitle: Polymer Reinforced Solder Paste for Improving Impact Energy Absorption Capability in Micro LED Laser-Assisted Mass Transfer
publicationTitle: 2023 20th China International Forum on Solid State Lighting & 2023 9th International Forum on Wide Bandgap Semiconductors (SSLCHINA: IFWS)
abstract: Micro LED displays offer superior performance compared to traditional LCD and OLED displays. However, challenges in transfer technology, such as high throughput and scalability, must be addressed. Among various mass transfer techniques, stamp transfer and laser-assisted transfer are widely used for Micro LED assembly. The laser-assisted transfer technique enables high-speed and accurate transfer. Anisotropic conductive film (ACF) is commonly used for its energy absorption properties during chip transfer. However, during the subsequent thermocompression bonding process, the ACF film needs to be ruptured, which adds no value to the bonding process. To address limitations, we have developed a polymer-reinforced solder paste that demonstrates high effectiveness in absorbing impact energy during chip dropping, providing performance comparable to ACF-like materials for die receiving. It also possesses typical solder paste characteristics, enabling the formation of reliable solder joints between the chip and substrate. This material facilitates streamlined manufacturing process and providing opportunities for chip rework in subsequent stages.

articleTitle: Preferences of Luminous Environment of Day and Night Shift Workers in the Enclosed Space with Different Sizes
publicationTitle: 2023 20th China International Forum on Solid State Lighting & 2023 9th International Forum on Wide Bandgap Semiconductors (SSLCHINA: IFWS)
abstract: Light environment is very important for enclosed spaces without natural light. This study aims to explore the preferences of workers for luminous environment in different enclosed spaces during different schedules. Two enclosed spaces of different sizes were constructed as experiment scenes, 6 light conditions with illuminance (200lx and 300lx) and CCT (3000K, 4500K and 5500K) were compared. Eight healthy males were recruited and experienced all light conditions during day and night schedule. D2 test, VAS-F scale and VSD scale were used to measure work performance, fatigue and visual perception, respectively. The results shown that participates have higher preference and coziness for big space. Compared with day schedule, the work performance of worker is worse at night according to the less uncompleted number and higher fatigue level. High illuminance (300lx) can decrease uncompleted number and relieve fatigue. Although participates felt livelier atmosphere under 300lx and 5500K, they had a preference for 3000K.

articleTitle: Optimization of Heteroepitaxial Gallium Oxide Thin Films on Diamond Composite Substrates using Pulsed Laser Deposition Method
publicationTitle: 2023 20th China International Forum on Solid State Lighting & 2023 9th International Forum on Wide Bandgap Semiconductors (SSLCHINA: IFWS)
abstract: Due to the large thermal and lattice mismatch between gallium oxide (Ga<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>) and diamond, the resulting residual stress brings high defect densities and susceptibility to cracking on the Ga<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> epilayer. To balance the stress-strain behavior and eliminate the dislocation defects, this study employed diamond composite substrates which consist of a pre-grown AlN strain interlayer on the surface of the bulk diamond to heteroepitaxy Ga<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> nanomembranes via pulsed laser deposition (PLD). To achieve an optimal solution of high-quality Ga<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> thin films, several comparative investigations were proposed and gave a preliminary exploration. Subsequently, spectroscopic ellipsometry (SE), high-resolution X-ray diffraction (HRXRD), atomic force microscopy (AFM), and X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy (XPS), were performed to characterize the physical, chemical, and optical properties. A comprehensive analysis was conducted on the quality of Ga<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> thin films dependent on the growth processes including oxygen pressure, in-situ annealing treatment, and the “two-step” growth. It demonstrated that high oxygen pressure significantly increased the growth rate of Ga<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> (∼ 2 times), slightly improved crystallinity and surface morphology (RMS decreased ∼ 2.2 nm), and reduced oxygen vacancy defects (∼ 3%). The additional in-situ annealing process and the “two-step” growth method also brought a bit of thickness increase (∼ 28 nm and ∼ 14 nm, respectively). By in-situ annealing in various stages, 2D and 3D growth modes competition caused Ga<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> thin films' continuous grain growth and fewer oxygen vacancy defects but presented different variations of surface morphology. On the whole, the “two-step” growth enhancement scheme proves the largest effect on Ga<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>'s quality among the designed sets of experiments. Exploring various optimization schemes and proposing a highly reliable growth technology route is of great significance to give impetus to Ga<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> application in the electric power field. Consequently, for further insight, continuous work will be propelled in the future.

articleTitle: Study of Vacuum Annealing Process of Ga2O3/4H-SiC Heterojunction
publicationTitle: 2023 20th China International Forum on Solid State Lighting & 2023 9th International Forum on Wide Bandgap Semiconductors (SSLCHINA: IFWS)
abstract: Gallium oxide (Ga<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>) is a strong contender for solar- blind ultraviolet photodetectors and power electronic devices. But poor thermal conductivity is an important barrier. In the paper, the vacuum annealed influences on the chemical component and interface microstructure of Ga<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> film based on the high thermal conductivity 4H-SiC substrate were thoroughly investigated. Atomic force microscope measurement indicated that a fivefold increase in roughness. The results of X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy and transmission electron microscopy demonstrated that the vacuum annealing resulted in the forming of silicon oxide. Selected area electron diffraction proved that β-Ga<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> film and 4H-SiC substrate have a specific epitaxial relationship of Ga<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>(−201)//4H-SiC(002). It provides a new solution for large area heterogeneous epitaxy with high quality.

articleTitle: Thermal Management of GaN Power Modules Using Copper Core PCBs with Direct Heatsink Pads
publicationTitle: 2023 20th China International Forum on Solid State Lighting & 2023 9th International Forum on Wide Bandgap Semiconductors (SSLCHINA: IFWS)
abstract: With the adoption of wide-bandgap (WBG) semiconductor devices in high power density applications, the thermal dissipation of this type of power modules has become a major challenge. In the power conversion applications with Gallium Nitride (GaN) high electron mobility transistors (HEMTs), the switching frequency is normally a few times higher than those using similar rated silicon devices. The increase in frequency can reduce the system's physical size and achieve a more compact design. However, the compactness of the module poses greater challenges on system's thermal design as the effective area for heat dissipation is reduced. A GaN based, buck converter module using copper core PCB with direct heatsink pad is designed and tested to demonstrate one possible methods of mitigating this issue. This module integrates input and output capacitors, four GaN transistors, four gate drivers and a coupled inductor to construct a two-phase buck converter that converts 12 to 5 V or 3.3 V. When operated at 500 kHz for a 12 to 5 V conversion with forced air cooling and additional heatsinks, this module can achieve a peak efficiency of 92.5% at 25 W of output power. It can deliver a maximum power of 176 W while maintaining the temperature of the GaN transistors to be below 90°C. At this maximum power, the power density is calculated to be 9.8 kW/L.

articleTitle: Fabrication and Characterization of 750V SiC MOSFET for New Energy Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2023 20th China International Forum on Solid State Lighting & 2023 9th International Forum on Wide Bandgap Semiconductors (SSLCHINA: IFWS)
abstract: For new energy vehicle applications, For 480V bus voltage, 750V SiC MOSFET device is the most suitable Power devices. In this paper, Simulation, Fabrication and Characterization of high current density 750V 11 mΩ SiC MOSFETs were reported, the breakdown voltage were 970V and the on-stae current were scaled up to 150A. Base on the simulation of drift epilayer, Doping of JFET region, the specific on-resistance reduced from 3.0mΩ-cm2 to 2.21mΩ- cm2.A 750V 800A full SiC Power Modules was fabricated, the power module shows fast switching characteristics with turn-on and turn-off times of 117 ns and 80 ns.

articleTitle: Monolithic III-Nitride Photonic Circuit for Integrated Sensing and Communication System
publicationTitle: 2023 20th China International Forum on Solid State Lighting & 2023 9th International Forum on Wide Bandgap Semiconductors (SSLCHINA: IFWS)
abstract: Multifunctional optoelectronic systems are highly demanded for the Internet of Things era. Here, we propose and fabricate a monolithic III-nitride photonic circuit to achieve on-chip sensing and communication simultaneously. Two identical InGaN/AlGaN multiple quantum well (MQW) diode separately work as light transmitter and receiver in the photonic circuit due to the electroluminescence/responsivity spectra overlap of the MQW diodes. The modulated light from the transmitter is guided by the comb waveguides and finally coupled into the receiver. The channels among the comb waveguides are capable of liquid sensing at the same time. Both on-chip light communication with a data rate of 40 Mbps and dynamic liquid sensing are achieved, opening a feasible route for the development of advanced monolithic III- nitride photonic circuit toward integrated sensing and communication system.

articleTitle: The Degradation and Recovery of 1200-V SiC MOSFET with Different Total Ionizing Doses
publicationTitle: 2023 20th China International Forum on Solid State Lighting & 2023 9th International Forum on Wide Bandgap Semiconductors (SSLCHINA: IFWS)
abstract: The cobalt irradiation experiments of the 1200V/20A rated silicon carbide (SiC) metal-oxide-semiconductor field-effect- transistor (MOSFET) were carried out under different total ionizing doses (TIDs). The shifts of the key electrical parameters, such as threshold voltage, on-resistance, breakdown voltage, and gate capacitance, were measured after irradiation and annealing processes. The mechanism for the effect of gate voltage on the radiation degradation of the devices was analyzed, and the room temperature annealing recovery was also explored. The results showed that the generated holes during irradiation were trapped in the oxide layer and SiO2/SiC interface, resulting in the degradation of the electrical parameters. The gate voltage affected the final yield of oxide-trapping charge, which leads to the difference of the degradation degrees of the devices after irradiation. Due to the relaxation of the oxide-trapping charge during the annealing process, the device electrical properties were partially recovered.

articleTitle: Advanced Down-Scaling Technology and its Physical Mechanism for 515 GHz GaN HEMT
publicationTitle: 2023 20th China International Forum on Solid State Lighting & 2023 9th International Forum on Wide Bandgap Semiconductors (SSLCHINA: IFWS)
abstract: GaN-based high electron mobility transistors (HEMTs) are considered suitable devices for power amplification in the millimeter wave frequency range owing to their notable advantages, including a high 2DEG concentration, a high electron saturation velocity, and a high breakdown electric field. In order to facilitate the development of future 6G communications, there is a pressing need for millimeter wave amplifiers operating at frequencies exceeding 100 GHz. To address this requirement, GaN HEMTs must possess a maximum oscillation frequency (f<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">max</inf>) surpassing 400 GHz. However, achieving this objective presents a considerable challenge in terms of advanced down-scaling technology and cost management. In this report, sapphire substrates and MOCVD were employed to produce an ultra-thin 4 nm AlN polarization layer on the 300 nm GaN channel layer to suppress short channel effect through vertical scaling. Using lateral scaling, T-gates with gate length less than 70 nm and S-D space ∼250 nm were fabricated to reduce the HEMT intrinsic delay. Selective area regrowth (SAG) of n<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">+</sup>-GaN source/drain electrodes was also implemented in order to mitigate access resistance and minimize parasitic delay. These components are crucial in achieving the successful fabrication of GaN HEMTs reach f<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">max</inf> of around 515 GHz with corresponding fT of around 150 GHz. To the best of the author's knowledge, our scaled HEMTs exhibit the highest fmax among reported HEMTs on sapphire. This study highlights the advantageous characteristics of GaN HEMTs on sapphire substrates, namely their ability to operate at high frequency and their high cost-effectiveness, making them a promising choice for millimeter-wave applications.

articleTitle: TCAD Simulation Analysis on Gate Structure and Trap Effect of GaN-Based Junctionless FinFETs
publicationTitle: 2023 20th China International Forum on Solid State Lighting & 2023 9th International Forum on Wide Bandgap Semiconductors (SSLCHINA: IFWS)
abstract: In this paper, the superiority of the triple-gate structure, the junctionless structure, and the overlapped-gate structure is successively confirmed by comparative simulations using Silvaco TCAD. Analyze and deduce the correspondence between each simulation parameter and the performance of the device by comparing the transfer characteristics and the output characteristics and other parameters. The results show that the fin structure enables enhanced gate control; the junctionless FinFET has an advantage over conventional FinFETs due to its insensitivity to the trap effect; and the overlapped-gate can significantly suppress the trap effect. In the last part of the article, we simulate the key parameters of junctionless FinFETs, and we infer that they will be very promising in the future with the miniaturization trend, as they have more advantages at smaller sizes.

articleTitle: Simultaneous Light Communication and Sensing of a Multi-Quantum Well Diode
publicationTitle: 2023 20th China International Forum on Solid State Lighting & 2023 9th International Forum on Wide Bandgap Semiconductors (SSLCHINA: IFWS)
abstract: When a multi-quantum well (MQW) diode is biased with a forward voltage and illuminated with an external shorter-wavelength light, the device simultaneously emits and senses light, with the injected current and the induced current mixed inside the wells. Here, we have developed a dual-function MQW diode utilizing the standard LED fabrication process flow and have experimentally demonstrated its capability to communicate and sense light simultaneously, eliminating the need for voltage switching between emitting and detecting modes. The results indicate that MQW diodes have the potential to be used as light emitting units in interactive human-computer displays.

articleTitle: Study of PEALD-AlN as Dielectric Layer in GaN MIS-HEMTs
publicationTitle: 2023 20th China International Forum on Solid State Lighting & 2023 9th International Forum on Wide Bandgap Semiconductors (SSLCHINA: IFWS)
abstract: In this paper, the Aluminum Nitride (AlN) film was investigated based on Plasma-Enhanced Atomic Layer Deposition (PEALD) by varying process parameters (RF power, NH3 pulse time, temperature). The optimized AlN achieved a high breakdown voltage of 18 V on Si. The 10 nm AlN film is demonstrated as a dielectric layer in GaN MIS- HEMTs. The devices exhibited a threshold voltage (<tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$V_{\text{TH}}$</tex>) of −4.4 V and a peak transconductance (gmax) that reached 171.3 mS/mm. Furthermore, the leakage current test results indicate that the device exhibits characteristics more aligned with Schottky contact performance.

articleTitle: Ultra-Low On-Resistance SiC LDMOS With Separated-Protected Trench Gates and Trench RESURF Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 20th China International Forum on Solid State Lighting & 2023 9th International Forum on Wide Bandgap Semiconductors (SSLCHINA: IFWS)
abstract: A novel SiC RESURF LDMOS, incorporating a trench Ptop layer and a composite structure comprising dual trench- gate and P-buried layers (PTG-TDR LDMOS), has been introduced to safeguard the gate oxide and enhance the breakdown voltage by optimizing the electric field distribution. The etched trenches within the Ptop layer, filled with a high dielectric constant medium, introduce electric field spikes at the trench corners, thereby refining the transverse electric field distribution and significantly bolstering the breakdown voltage. The trench gate reduces channel resistance, while the P-buried layer diminishes the gate oxide electric field and provides protection. The presence of both the P-buried layer and the trench Ptop layer contributes to the depletion of the Drift region, thereby increasing the doping concentration and reducing Ron,sp effectively. The results demonstrate that the proposed device achieved a remarkable breakdown voltage (BV) of 1645 V and a specific on-resistance (Ron,sp) of 2.73 mΩ·cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> (at VGS = 15V, VDS = 5V). Consequently, Baliga's figure of merit (FOM), defined as BV<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>/Ron,sp, experienced a substantial 202% improvement, reaching 991.2 MW/cm², when compared to the conventional double RESURF LDMOS.

articleTitle: Influence of Temperature on Dynamic and Static Parameters of 6.5kV Welding SiC MOSFET Module
publicationTitle: 2023 20th China International Forum on Solid State Lighting & 2023 9th International Forum on Wide Bandgap Semiconductors (SSLCHINA: IFWS)
abstract: The test of dynamic and static parameters are the necessary step for SiC MOSFET (Silicon Carbide Metal- Oxide-Field-Effect-Transistor) module to be verified after packaging. In this paper, the 6.5kV/100A welding SiC module is selected to test the dynamic and static parameters at room temperature and high temperature successively. The module is packaged by our team with two 6.5kV/50A SiC MOSFET and two 6.5kV/50A SiC SBD (Schottky Barrier Diode) based on 6-inch SiC wafer developed by our company. The influence of temperature on the static and dynamic parameters is analyzed by data extraction, calculating the rate of change and drawing the radar comparison diagram. Combined with the working principle of SiC MOSFET and SiC SBD chip inside the module, the main reason of the change of dynamic and static parameters caused by temperature is studied.

articleTitle: Enhanced Performance in Deep-Ultraviolet Light-Emitting Diodes with an Undoped AlInGaN Graded Hole Reservoir Layer
publicationTitle: 2023 20th China International Forum on Solid State Lighting & 2023 9th International Forum on Wide Bandgap Semiconductors (SSLCHINA: IFWS)
abstract: To alleviate the problem of low hole injection efficiency in deep ultraviolet light-emitting diodes (DUV LED), an undoped AlInGaN graded hole reservoir layer is designed in this paper to improve the hole injection efficiency. According to the simulation results, the adoption of this structure significantly improves the output power and internal quantum efficiency (IQE) of the LED, which provides insights into the development of high-performance DUV LED.

articleTitle: Epitaxial Growth of High-Quality GaN Films Based on Bilayer Graphene
publicationTitle: 2023 20th China International Forum on Solid State Lighting & 2023 9th International Forum on Wide Bandgap Semiconductors (SSLCHINA: IFWS)
abstract: Remote epitaxial GaN thin films are important to study for the preparation of flexible optoelectronic devices. In this paper, the growth of GaN films on graphene was carried out by a two-step method, and a dense nucleation layer was formed on graphene by regulating the growth parameters, and GaN films with good uniformity were obtained during the high-temperature film formation process. GaN films grown on AlN/sapphire templates were compared under the same growth conditions. The surface roughness, dislocation density, and film stress of GaN films grown on graphene were found to be superior to those grown on AlN/sapphire templates. It lays a foundation for the subsequent epitaxy of high-quality GaN films and the preparation of high-performance devices.

articleTitle: High Strength die Attaching Structure Fabricated via in Situ Reduction-Sintering of Micron Copper Paste
publicationTitle: 2023 20th China International Forum on Solid State Lighting & 2023 9th International Forum on Wide Bandgap Semiconductors (SSLCHINA: IFWS)
abstract: A novel in-situ reduction method was designed to remove the native oxide on the micro-sized Cu particles’ surface during sintering. Ascorbic acid was innovatively introduced into the organic solvent as a reducing agent to prepare a micron Cu paste. The fresh copper surface was obtained by the reduction of oxide copper particles, which significantly improved surface activity and diffusivity. The sintered die attaching interconnection can achieve a shear strength of 57 MPa which is much higher than most published references, especially for a low sintering temperature of 250 °C.

articleTitle: Research on a Multi-Output LED Driver and Its Weighted Dimming Strategy
publicationTitle: 2023 20th China International Forum on Solid State Lighting & 2023 9th International Forum on Wide Bandgap Semiconductors (SSLCHINA: IFWS)
abstract: For the application in multi-color spectrum combined dimming of LED plant lighting, a multi-output LED driver based on corresponding spectral demanded by combining constant current Boost circuit unit with injection current Buck circuit unit is proposed in this paper. The operating principle and operating process of the proposed driver, and the relationship between the number of LEDs on the lamp(left) and the lamp (right) and the corresponding spectrum voltage regulation range is analyzed in detail. For the application occasions of plant lighting dimming of the proposed driver, a weighted dimming control strategy is proposed and the principle of the control strategy is analyzed in detail, which high efficiency and wide range dimming can be realized. At the same time, the key parameters of the power stage and the control circuit of the proposed driver are designed. A prototype of the proposed driver with 3-channel output (single-channel rated power 7W) was built. The effectiveness of the proposed combined driver and weighted dimming control strategy has been verified by experimental results.

articleTitle: Influence of Fin Configurations on the GaN HEMTs under High-Voltage Bias
publicationTitle: 2023 20th China International Forum on Solid State Lighting & 2023 9th International Forum on Wide Bandgap Semiconductors (SSLCHINA: IFWS)
abstract: As the demand for high-performance high-electron mobility transistors (HEMTs) increasing, fin configurations have become crucial for improving device performance. Nevertheless, there are few researches on the reliability of Fin-HEMTs under high-voltage bias. In this article, we have explored the influence of fin configurations on the electric field distribution of GaN-based HEMTs under high-voltage operating conditions through Silvaco TCAD simulation, thereby determining the locations of the failure points with one located at the middle surface of the barrier layer near the gate edge close to drain and the others located at the side gate feet near the drain. Furthermore, through comprehensive consideration of the influence of fin configurations on the high field performance and reliability of the devices, it is concluded that within a certain range, the smaller fin width (W<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">Fin</sub>) and larger fin height (H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">Fin</sub>) generate smaller peak electric field strength. Moreover, W<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">Fin</sub> has a great impact on the electric field strength of the barrier layer while H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">Fin</sub> has a great impact on that of the buffer layer. In general, these conclusions provide guidance for commercial device design.

articleTitle: Simulation Study on Electrothermal and Mechanical Coupling of Bumps in 5×5 Micro-LED Array
publicationTitle: 2023 20th China International Forum on Solid State Lighting & 2023 9th International Forum on Wide Bandgap Semiconductors (SSLCHINA: IFWS)
abstract: As a frontier research field of next-generation display technology, Micro-LED technology has the advantages of high brightness, high contrast and high energy efficiency. With the development trend of high-power, multi-array LEDs, the research on thermal stability of LEDs is gradually deepened. In order to explore the thermal stability of bumps during the working of Micro-LED, COMSOL Multiphysics simulation software and finite element method were used to analyze the electrothermal and mechanical coupling of bumps in 5×5 Micro-LED array in this paper. Flip-chip bonding was employed for interconnection of Micro-LED array and Si driver chip with the gap except Micro-LED devices between sapphire and silicon substrate filled with underfill to alleviate the stress concentration. The effects of different filling materials, applied current densities, and dimensions of In bumps (cylindrical) on thermal stress and displacement of the Micro-LED array were analyzed in detail. The results show the stress and displacement of the bumps with polyimide (PI) underfill were the smallest than that of bumps with benzocyclobutene (BCB) and epoxy resin (EP) underfill. Additionally, the temperature, thermal stress, and displacement of the bumps were also affected by the applied current density and the size of the bumps.

articleTitle: Simulation Study of p-GaN HEMT with Gate Floating Metal Rings
publicationTitle: 2023 20th China International Forum on Solid State Lighting & 2023 9th International Forum on Wide Bandgap Semiconductors (SSLCHINA: IFWS)
abstract: In this paper, the effect of GFMR on the gate breakdown voltage is investigated by Silvaco simulated software. The gate breakdown voltage increases from 7 V to 16.1 V by adopting GFMR structure, which is attributed to more uniform distribution of the electric field. The GFMR introduces a new electric field peak, and reduces the main peak value, thus improving breakdown voltage. However, the GFMR cannot give full play to the ability to disperse electric field, due to heavily-doped in the p-GaN layer. The heavily- doped will limit the depletion region expanding and concentrated electric field. Therefore, the lightly-doped and heavily-doped stacking p-GaN layer is proposed to optimize GFMR structure. The lightly-doped layer makes the depletion region easy to expand, and heavily-doped layer ensures the realization of enhancement devices. The results show that the gate breakdown voltage can achieve 23.8 V, 3 times higher than conventional p-GaN HEMT.

articleTitle: A High Efficiency Composite Junction Termination for SiC Power Devices
publicationTitle: 2023 20th China International Forum on Solid State Lighting & 2023 9th International Forum on Wide Bandgap Semiconductors (SSLCHINA: IFWS)
abstract: Breakdown voltage of termination region for power devices usually determines the really breakdown of a power device. When designing a high-voltage termination, interface charges always play an importance role, especially for Junction Termination Extension (JTE), since it directly affects the total effective charge for the termination. For Silicon Carbide (SiC) devices, another issue is that accurate control of effective acceptor dose in the JTE region is difficult since p-type dopants in SiC is not easy to be fully activated. To enlarge the design window for JTE and investigate the influence of interface charges on breakdown voltage, in this paper, we fabricated a junction termination with combined JTE and floating P+ rings for high efficiency design. The total length of the terminal is ∼55 μm, with 6 Floating P+ Rings (FPRs) in the JTE region. The measured breakdown voltage for the JTE with FPRs is over 1.3 kV, which is improve by about 26%, compared with fabricated pure JTE having a length of 60 μm. However, the measured breakdown voltage is lower than our simulated ones with negative interface charge assumed before experiment, which may be caused by positive charge at the interface of oxide/SiC. After calibration by TCAD tools, the interface charge at the SiO2/SiC interface in the terminal region is estimated to be ∼3.5×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">12</sup> cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-2</sup>. Based on the calibration, the terminal region was re-designed to sustain a breakdown voltage over 1.5 kV with wide design window for the space between floating P+ rings.

articleTitle: A Short Channel Self-Alignment Process for High-Voltage VDMOSFETs in 4H-SiC
publicationTitle: 2023 20th China International Forum on Solid State Lighting & 2023 9th International Forum on Wide Bandgap Semiconductors (SSLCHINA: IFWS)
abstract: Short channel is an effective method to reduce the channel resistance, which accounts for a large proportion of the total resistance due to the high interface state of the gate oxide for 4H-SiC VDMOSFET. The self-aligning processes were developed to obtain the different channel lengths smaller than 1 μm for MOSFET in this paper. Following the P-well ion implantation with an SiO2 film as a mask, multiple thicknesses of oxide film are grown by PECVD or LPCVD. Then 0.5μm, 0.6μm, 0.7μm side walls are accessed by dry etching process. The results of the SEM test showed that the intra-wafer uniformity variances are 8.06%, 4.48% and 4.71% for the 0.5μm, 0.6μm, 0.7μm channel, respectively. And the electrical test results show that the device resistance decreases by 50% when the channel size is reduced from 0.7um to 0.5um.

articleTitle: A Novel Silicon Carbide Insulated Gate Bipolar Transistor with Short Super Junction
publicationTitle: 2023 20th China International Forum on Solid State Lighting & 2023 9th International Forum on Wide Bandgap Semiconductors (SSLCHINA: IFWS)
abstract: A novel silicon carbide (SiC) insulated gate bipolar transistor with short super junction (SSJ-IGBT) is proposed in this article. The specific ON-resistance (RON,sp) of SSJ-IGBT is decreased by 10.87% compared with conventional IGBT (C-IGBT). Due to the fact that the high doping in the N-pillar causes the low resistance and improves the conductivity modulation. The P-well in the SSJ-IGBT is fully protected by the super junction. Thus, a reduced corner field below 2 MV/cm can be achieved in the OFF-state. Furthermore, due to the SSJ structure, the carriers can be drifted to the buffer layer more easily by the electric field in the depletion region. Therefore, a low turn-OFF loss (125.78 mJ/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>) has been achieved for the SSJ-IGBT. These results show that SSJ-IGBT structure has great tradeoff between the ON-state and turn-OFF loss, indicating the potential for ultrahigh-voltage power electronic of the future.

articleTitle: Electrical Performance Analysis of AlGaN/GaN Fin-HEMTs with Different Gate Structures by TCAD Simulation
publicationTitle: 2023 20th China International Forum on Solid State Lighting & 2023 9th International Forum on Wide Bandgap Semiconductors (SSLCHINA: IFWS)
abstract: In this paper, AlGaN/GaN fin-shaped high-electron mobility transistors (Fin-HEMTs) with different gate structures are simulated in 3-D TCAD. By comparing the transfer and transconductance curves and observing the two-dimensional electron gas (2-DEG) distribution underneath the gate, the effect of gate variations on the threshold voltage of AlGaN/GaN Fin-HEMTs is investigated in three dimensions: width, height, and length. The results show that Fin devices have better gate control compared to planar devices and that the threshold voltage of Fin devices is inversely proportional to the width of the gate and, conversely, proportional to the height and length of the gate, which provides a reference for miniaturized device design.

articleTitle: Electrical Characteristics Analysis of AlGaN/GaN FinFET and TSEP Junction Temperature Test of GaN Devices
publicationTitle: 2023 20th China International Forum on Solid State Lighting & 2023 9th International Forum on Wide Bandgap Semiconductors (SSLCHINA: IFWS)
abstract: The third generation semiconductors with wide band-gap (WBG) mainly composed of SiC and GaN have excellent switching characteristics and are very popular in the market. With the chip size shrinking, the channel of the device is getting shorter and shorter, which is easy to cause short channel effect. Breaking through the channel length barrier has become the research focus; With the chip size shrinking, the volume of active region is getting smaller and smaller, and the influence of temperature on the reliability of devices is increasing, so the measurement of temperature rise and thermal resistance becomes an important work. The main research contents of this paper are as follows: (1) Using Silvaco TCAD software, 3D modeling of FinFET and the other two devices is carried out, and the electrical characteristics of the three devices are obtained and compared. Then, the transfer characteristics and transconductance characteristics of different Fin widths and Fin heights are tested, and the characteristic curves are obtained and analyzed; (2) Through TSEP method, the boost converter circuit is built with LTspice software to deduce the variation of junction temperature and shell temperature, and the junction temperature and other electrical characteristics are analyzed when the driving resistance is different.

articleTitle: Market Research on FPD Mask Making Lithography Equipment
publicationTitle: 2023 20th China International Forum on Solid State Lighting & 2023 9th International Forum on Wide Bandgap Semiconductors (SSLCHINA: IFWS)
abstract: Mask is a graphic transfer master in the microelectronics manufacturing process and an important key consumable in the production and manufacturing process of the FPD industry. Making masks requires the use of lithography equipment, and maskless lithography equipment is one of the excellent equipment for making masks. Therefore, this article conducts market research on lithography equipment used for manufacturing FPD masks.

articleTitle: Raman Characterization of Carbon Clusters at the 4H-SiC/Ni Interface of SiC Power Devices Against Different Annealing Methods
publicationTitle: 2023 20th China International Forum on Solid State Lighting & 2023 9th International Forum on Wide Bandgap Semiconductors (SSLCHINA: IFWS)
abstract: In this paper, the ohmic contact resistance, the structure of interface materials and the characteristics of carbon clusters at the 4H-SiC/Ni interface are examined to gain an insight into the formation of ohmic contact between Ni and 4H-SiC of SiC power devices. In this work, the experiment results show that the pulsed laser annealing process can obtain low ohmic contact resistance on 4H-SiC. In addition, the characterization of carbon cluster by Raman spectroscopy is discussed. It is concluded that more carbon vacancies and smaller carbon cluster particle size can be obtained by pulsed laser annealing. The results of this study provide insights into the ohmic contact interface and show that pulsed laser annealing is attractive ohmic contact process for high performance SiC power devices.

articleTitle: Termination Design of 6.5kV SiC MOSFET with Epitaxial Current Spreading Layer
publicationTitle: 2023 20th China International Forum on Solid State Lighting & 2023 9th International Forum on Wide Bandgap Semiconductors (SSLCHINA: IFWS)
abstract: Epitaxial Current Spreading Layer (CSL) is an effective structure for decreasing specific on-resistance and optimizing forward characteristic of 4H-SiC unipolar power devices, such as JBS and MOSFET. However, the relatively high-doping epitaxy of CSL may result in efficiency reduction and process window narrowing of the edge termination. This is of significant importance for high voltage devices. In this work, 6.5kV edge terminations on 1μm thick and 3×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">16</sup>cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−3</sup> doped CSL epitaxy were analyzed and optimized by TCAD simulation, including Field Limited Rings (FLRs) and Multiple Zone Single Mask Junction Termination Extension (MZ-JTE). It is found that with the inclusion of CSL, the breakdown voltage is only decreased by 6% and 4.2% with optimized FLRs and MZ-JTE, while the specific on resistance of 6.5kV 4H-SiC MOSFET devices were reduced by 15%. Notably, the optimized FLRs with CSL demonstrated a process window of approximately ∼0.6μm, while the optimized MZ-JTE with CSL exhibited a doping window of approximately ∼1×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">17</sup>cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−3</sup>. All the edge terminations analyzed in this article are single-implant.

articleTitle: Investigation on Single Pulse Avalanche Failure of 1200V SiC MOSFETs at Different Temperatures
publicationTitle: 2023 20th China International Forum on Solid State Lighting & 2023 9th International Forum on Wide Bandgap Semiconductors (SSLCHINA: IFWS)
abstract: The avalanche ruggedness of SiC MOSFETs becomes a crucial issue to ensure the safe operation of the power conversion systems, especially under different temperature conditions. It's important to research on the avalanche failure of SiC, however, there is currently no clear conclusion on its failure mechanism. In this work, avalanche ruggedness and failure mechanism of SiC MOSFET in single-pulse Unclamped Inductive Switching (UIS) test were investigated through experimental evaluation at temperatures ranging from 25°C to 125°C, together with TCAD simulation. A 1200V planar commercialized SiC MOSFET device was chosen as a device under test (DUT) for this study. The results showed that the breakdown voltage of the SiC MOSFET exhibited a gradual upward trend with the increase of the temperature conditions. To study the avalanche failure mechanism of SiC MOSFETs more comprehensively, a TCAD simulation model had been established in this project and the DUT was decapped. A mechanism for SiC MOSFET failure (thermal failure) has been proposed.

articleTitle: Growth of 150 mm 4H-SiC Epilayers with Low Surface Roughness by a Hot-Wall Reactor on 4° off- Axis Substrates
publicationTitle: 2023 20th China International Forum on Solid State Lighting & 2023 9th International Forum on Wide Bandgap Semiconductors (SSLCHINA: IFWS)
abstract: Homoepitaxial growth has been performed on 4° off-axis 150 mm diameter 4H-SiC (0001) Si-face substrate by using our home-made hot wall LPCVD reactor. According to the result, we have obtained 4H-SiC epitaxial layers with excellent uniformity for thickness and doping, as well as in surface roughness in standard epitaxy on 150 mm wafers. After the improvement, the 10 to 11 μm thick epilayer with the thickness and doping uniformities (δ/mean) of <1.0% and <5%, respectively, could be routinely achieved. Surface roughness of the as-grown 150 mm 4H-SiC epitaxial layer has an RMS value of 0.13 nm scanned by AFM on 10×10 μm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> areas. The results of 150 mm 4H-SiC epitaxial growths demonstrate that this home-made hot wall reactor offers the opportunity for mass production of large diameter 4H-SiC epitaxial wafers with high quality.

articleTitle: High-Bandwidth Micro-LED Serving as Photodetector Toward 10-Gbps Visible Light Communication
publicationTitle: 2023 20th China International Forum on Solid State Lighting & 2023 9th International Forum on Wide Bandgap Semiconductors (SSLCHINA: IFWS)
abstract: In this work, we fabricated a green micro-LED on sapphire substrates and proposed it as a high-speed photodetector for visible light communication (VLC). We tested the photocurrent and frequency response characteristics of the device. A record modulation bandwidth of 878.8 MHz was achieved by a 20 μm device at a reverse bias voltage of − 50 V. A 20 μm single micro-LED was used as a PD in the VLC system with a free space transmission distance of 0.3 m, and a maximum communication rate of 9.9279 Gbps was achieved below the forward error correction (FEC) limit of 3.8×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-3</sup> by the orthogonal frequency division multiplexing (OFDM) modulation scheme and a bit-loading algorithm.

articleTitle: Fabrication and Study of Micro-LED Quantum Dot Color Conversion Layer Based on Inkjet Printing
publicationTitle: 2023 20th China International Forum on Solid State Lighting & 2023 9th International Forum on Wide Bandgap Semiconductors (SSLCHINA: IFWS)
abstract: In this study, red and green quantum dot color conversion layer was successfully fabricated using inkjet printing (IJP) technology on a blue micro-light-emitting diode (Micro-LED) backlight. To reduce the optical crosstalk between different sub-pixels, a black matrix (BM) layer with a thickness of 15 μm was proposed. Furthermore, to protect quantum dots (QDs), a SiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> passivation layer with a thickness of 3 nm was uniformly deposited on the entire pattern by Atomic Layer Deposition (ALD). Subsequently, a pixel array featuring a sub-pixel size of 37.5 μm and a line width of 2 μm was fabricated on the BM layer treated with Reactive Ion Etching (RIE), and the thickness of the QDCC layer was controlled by RIE. The external quantum efficiencies of the red and green QDCC layer were 12.9% and 18.2%, respectively, and the emission spectra had blue light being transmitted, accompanied by a slight redshift. This research addresses the gaps in display applications and holds promise for the future advancement of Micro-LED display technology.

articleTitle: Study of Blue/Green Dual Wavelength LED Chip for Wide Color Gamut in Backlighting Application
publicationTitle: 2023 20th China International Forum on Solid State Lighting & 2023 9th International Forum on Wide Bandgap Semiconductors (SSLCHINA: IFWS)
abstract: Utilizing downconverters with a narrow emission lin- ewidth and a precisely tunable peak is a common approach to obtain wide color gamut (WCG) in today's backlighting for TV and monitor displays. Narrow band green and red phosphors such as b-SiAlON and KSF or quantum dots (QDs) are used to convert blue LEDs to white lights. How- ever, the narrow band green color needs improvement, es- pecially in on-chip configuration. The green b-SiAlON phosphor has FWHM around 50nm and its peak wave- length is in the range of 529nm to 540nm and can't be low- er, while the green quantum dots is less reliable than red ones due to its smaller size and high tendency to decay in high temperature and high humidity conditions. This paper explores a new structure by using a blue/green dual-color monolithic LED to excite narrow band red color converter for WCG backlighting. The LED chip comprises a regular blue wavelength region for the electroluminescence (EL) emission, and a native photoluminescence (PL) region for green color conversion. It can precisely tune the wave- length and green to blue spectral power ratio. We will dis- cuss the LED packaging structure, the backlighting metrics, and reliability test results in comparison to the conventional single wavelength blue LED and narrow band phosphor approaches. It shows that the blue/green dual-color chip combining with KSF red phosphor can achieve a wider color gamut than blue LED combining with b-SiAlON and KSF approaches. The optoelectrical characteristics depend- ence of junction temperature as well as the reliability test results will be discussed.

articleTitle: Investigation of the Trap States in Fully-Recessed Normally off LPCVD-Si3N4/PEALD-AlN/GaN MIS-HEMT with in-Situ N2 or H2/N2 Plasma Pretreatment
publicationTitle: 2023 20th China International Forum on Solid State Lighting & 2023 9th International Forum on Wide Bandgap Semiconductors (SSLCHINA: IFWS)
abstract: Fully recessed normally off LPCVD-Si3N4/PEALD-AlN/GaN MIS-HEMTs are fabricated with self-terminating wet etch technique. The effects of in-situ N2 or H2/N2 plasma treatments prior to the deposition of PEALD-AlN on the trap states of the device are studied. The interface trap density(Dit) is extracted using the multi-frequency capacitance-voltage (MFCV) method, whereas the border trap density (Nt) is extracted using the low frequency noise (1/f noise) method. The total Dit of devices with in-situ N2 and H2/N2 plasma pretreatment are 9.86 × 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">12</sup> and 8.51 × 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">12</sup> eV<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup>cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-2</sup>, respectively, an order of magnitude lower than no plasma pretreatment (1.52 × 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">13</sup> eV<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup>cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-2</sup>). The Nt of devices with no plasma pretreatment, in-situ N2 and H2/N2 plasma pretreatment are 6.20 × 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">19</sup> ∼ 7.26 × 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">19</sup>, 5.04 × 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">18</sup> ∼ 7.97 × 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">18</sup> and 3.05 × 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">18</sup> ∼ 4.06 × 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">18</sup> eV<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup>cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-3</sup>, respectively. These results indicate that the in-situ H2/N2 plasma pretreatment is more effective at reducing the trap density compared to in-situ N2 plasma pretreatment. Besides, it is found that the plasma pretreatment process may suppress border trap better than interface trap.

articleTitle: Deep-Ultraviolet Disinfection System and its Application in the Cryogenic Environment
publicationTitle: 2023 20th China International Forum on Solid State Lighting & 2023 9th International Forum on Wide Bandgap Semiconductors (SSLCHINA: IFWS)
abstract: The impact of the complex environment and cargo situation on the DUV dose had always been a challenging issue. This study designed a deep-ultraviolet (DUV) disinfection passageway-type system with specific optical design, in which the DUV light modules (wavelength ranging from 270 to 280 nm) were installed on the top, bottom, left, and right surfaces. The DUV inactivation test of staphylococcus aureus (ATCC 6538) and bacillus atrophaeus (ATCC 9372) on two widely used carriers in the food cold chain logistics were conducted in the cryogenic environment. The study found that the impact of temperature, material, or DUV dose on virucidal efficacy were different. The woven bag exhibited significantly poor virucidal efficacy compared to corrugated boxes at DUV dose levels of 37.5 mJ/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> and 75.0 mJ/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>. However, at higher DUV doses (e.g., 150.0 mJ/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>, 225.0 mJ/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2,</sup> and 450.0 mJ/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>), the woven bag demonstrated notably superior virucidal efficacy when compared to corrugated boxes. Furthermore, the work have simulated the DUV light uniformity, optimized the inner light distribution, and analyzed the influence of material reflectivity for the evaluation of the disinfection effect in the cryogenic environment.

articleTitle: Monolithic Integration of Light Emitting Diode, Waveguide Modulator, and Photodiode on a GaN-on- Si LED Epitaxial Wafer
publicationTitle: 2023 20th China International Forum on Solid State Lighting & 2023 9th International Forum on Wide Bandgap Semiconductors (SSLCHINA: IFWS)
abstract: Monolithic integration of light-emitting diode (LED), waveguide modulator and photodetector (PD) were realized based on a AlGaN/InGaN multiple quantum well (MQW) LED epitaxial wafer. Those components share the same quantum well structure and are fabricated without additional epitaxial material growth and ion implantation, offering a cost-effective method. Experimental results show that when the volage of the modulator is fixed, the modulation photocurrent received by the PD has a linear relationship with the injection current of the LED. This on-chip integrated devices pave a way for gallium nitride optoelectronic applications.

articleTitle: Subthreshold Swing Model of GaN-Based Fin-Gate High Electron Mobility Transistors
publicationTitle: 2023 20th China International Forum on Solid State Lighting & 2023 9th International Forum on Wide Bandgap Semiconductors (SSLCHINA: IFWS)
abstract: Compared to the traditional HEMTs, better gate control ability especially smaller subthreshold swing, can be achieved with a fin-gate structure, which can be widely used in power, RF circuits. However, there has been few works related to subthreshold swing reported previously. In this study, a Fin- HEMT device is investigated by TCAD simulation, and a subthreshold swing model was constructed. The simulation results verify the performance of the model. According to the simulation results, with an error of less than 6%, this work provide design guidlines for the research of Fin-HEMT devices.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Planck Blackbody Trajectory High Imitation Natural Light Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 20th China International Forum on Solid State Lighting & 2023 9th International Forum on Wide Bandgap Semiconductors (SSLCHINA: IFWS)
abstract: The research content is based on the existing digital control technology, colorimetry and photometry technology, using the digital characteristics of semiconductor light-emitting diode, design an algorithm to maximize the simulation of natural light. Based on the characteristics of natural light spectrum and the change rule of natural light along the blackbody track with time, the light source involved in light color regulation (whose color coordinate value is the coordinate corresponding to the end point of the target mixing area on the known blackbody track) is calculated with the linear equation based on Glassman's color mixing law. The calculated brightness coefficient is used as the input parameter of the dimming control unit. To achieve high quality and smooth light output along the Planck blackbody trajectory. So that the output target light is closer to natural light, both in terms of spectrum distribution, chroma, light intensity change rhythm are more similar to natural light, more suitable for human physiological and psychological needs.

articleTitle: Research Progress on Performance Optimization of Ga2O3 SBD
publicationTitle: 2023 20th China International Forum on Solid State Lighting & 2023 9th International Forum on Wide Bandgap Semiconductors (SSLCHINA: IFWS)
abstract: Gallium oxide (Ga2O3) is a booming ultrawide bandgap semiconductor material to fabricate power devices which has a wider band gap, ultra-high critical breakdown field strength, and higher Baliga's Figure of Merit (BFOM) than GaN and SiC. Nowadays, better Ga2O3 SBDs are developing towards higher breakdown voltage and lower specific on-resistance. Due to the Baliga curve, the specific on-resistance and breakdown voltage of the device is always a trade-off, so various explorations of optimization of Ga2O3 SBD have been employed. In this article, the latest progress of the G<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> SBD is consolidated from the fabrication process and architecture improvement. It will begin with a summary of properties of Ga2O3 and the advantages and existing problems of Ga2O3 SBD. The researchers have solved the problems of epitaxial layer quality and electric field distribution by utilizing multiple advanced fabrication processes, such as epitaxial process, reactive ion etching, heat treatment, etc., and thus improved the performance of Ga2O3 SBD. Different state-of- the-art architectures such as field plate (FP), trench structure, p-NiO/n-Ga2O3 heterojunction, etc. are introduced in detail to illustrate the optimization of the device. It is expected to help researchers summarize recent advances in the performance optimization of Ga2O3 SBD.

articleTitle: Quasi-Vertical GaN Schottky Barrier Diode on Sapphire Substrate With 109 High ION/IOFF and Excellent Forward Performance
publicationTitle: 2023 20th China International Forum on Solid State Lighting & 2023 9th International Forum on Wide Bandgap Semiconductors (SSLCHINA: IFWS)
abstract: In this letter, we reported a high performance quasi-vertical GaN Schottky Barrier Diode (GaN SBD) on sapphire substrate by combining Argon-ion implantation with Oxygen plasma termination, the leakage current density of the device decreases by about an order of magnitude in reverse 25-75 V compared with Argon-ion implantation alone. The turn-on voltage of the device is only 0.46 V, the ideal factor η = 1.05, and the specific on-resistance is 1.01 mΩ·cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>, while high ION/IOFF (∼10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">9</sup>) and large breakdown voltage (190 V) are maintained.

articleTitle: A novel double PN-junction Isolation Substrate for Isolating High and Low Side HEMTs in Half-bridge Integrated Circuits
publicationTitle: 2023 20th China International Forum on Solid State Lighting & 2023 9th International Forum on Wide Bandgap Semiconductors (SSLCHINA: IFWS)
abstract: In conventional monolithic integrated half-bridge circuits, the High Side (HS) High Electron Mobility Transistor (HEMT) and Low Side (LS) HEMT can experience mutual interference due to differing substrate potentials. While existing single PN-junction isolation structures have demonstrated effective isolation capabilities, ensuring this isolation typically necessitates the connection of the substrate to Vin, which poses challenges in terms of packaging and heat dissipation. This paper builds upon the foundation of single PN-junction isolation substrate structures and introduces a novel Double PN-junction Isolation Substrate (DJIS) structure. Sentaurus TCAD simulations have substantiated the positive correlation between trench depth and substrate breakdown voltage. The assessment of the isolation performance of DJIS is based on the observation of the impact of different VSW on threshold voltage shifts. It indicate that the DJIS structure ensures robust withstand voltage and isolation capabilities, whether the substrate potential is grounded or connected to Vin. Moreover, the incorporation of a P+ Si layer at the bottom enhances the elastic modulus and hardness of DJIS, thus elevating the device's reliability. The structure proposed in this paper offers a fresh perspective for achieving isolation in monolithic integrated half-bridge circuits.

articleTitle: Hybrid bonding thermodynamic simulation of 3×3 array of Micro-LED fabricated based on flip-chip bonding
publicationTitle: 2023 20th China International Forum on Solid State Lighting & 2023 9th International Forum on Wide Bandgap Semiconductors (SSLCHINA: IFWS)
abstract: In this paper, ANSYS was used to perform a hybrid bonding thermodynamic simulation of Micro-LED fabricated based on flip-chip bonding.We simulated the effects of different ILDs (interlayer dielectrics) and different diameters of In bumps on the mean stress of the bonding surface. The results show that filling BCB (Benzo cyclobutene)/PI (Polyimide)/SiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> can significantly reduce the mean stress on the In bumps bonding area, among which, filling BCB/PI is better than filling SiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>. And when the diameter of the In bumps is 5 μm, the mean stress on the In bumps bonding area is lowest. For the mean stress on the bonding area of the ILDs, filling BCB/PI is also much better than filling SiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>. Changing the diameter of the In bumps has little effect on the mean stress of the ILDs bonding area filled with BCB/PI. As for the bonding area of the ILDs filled with SiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>, the mean stress increases as the diameter of the In bumps increases. This paper uses simulation experiments to study the mean stress on different bonding areas during the hybrid bonding process of preparing Micro-LED, which provides a theoretical basis for improving the bonding strength and yield of Micro-LED, and provides ideas for realizing the industrialization of Micro- LED.

articleTitle: Study on the Influence of Defects in Recessed-Gate GaN MIS-HEMTs by TCAD Simulation
publicationTitle: 2023 20th China International Forum on Solid State Lighting & 2023 9th International Forum on Wide Bandgap Semiconductors (SSLCHINA: IFWS)
abstract: In this study, the basic structure and composition of the recessed-gate Gallium Nitride High Electron Mobility Transistor (GaN HEMT) are characterized by reverse engineering using microscopic analysis techniques, and a series of device parameters are obtained to establish a reliable simulation model of the devices by Technology Computer- Aided Design (TCAD) simulation. Notably, this study focuses on introducing traps at different positions along the interface between the AlGaN barrier layer and the insulator layer as well as within the GaN buffer layer to conduct distinct simulation analyses. Simulation results reveal that under open-state conditions, traps within the device lead to performance degradation through the phenomenon of hot electron effects, resulting in a reduction in drain-source saturation current and a positive drift in the threshold voltage. Importantly, our findings differ from previous research on non-recessed-structured devices, as we observe that defects at the recessed gate interfaces exert the most significant influence on the degradation of electrical properties of MIS- HEMT devices. It is noteworthy that the device degradation increases with increasing trap density. The simulation results presented in this paper provide valuable theoretical support for future experimental studies.

articleTitle: Fabrication of Low Parasitic 750V/800A 4H-SiC Power MOSFET module
publicationTitle: 2023 20th China International Forum on Solid State Lighting & 2023 9th International Forum on Wide Bandgap Semiconductors (SSLCHINA: IFWS)
abstract: Benefitted from the high operating temperature, high switching frequency and superior blocking voltage, SiC MOSFET is regarded as the most potential candidate to take place of Si IGBT in 650V-3300V power applications. In this paper, a low parasitic 750V/800A SiC power MOSFET module is reported using the 750V SiC MOSFET chip independently developed by the research group. The magnetic field cancellation effect of the commutation loop and parallel multi-current path design combined with multi-power terminal design technology was used to lower parasitic inductance. The on-state resistance of module is 1.61mΩ when T<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">j</inf> = 25℃ and the corresponding threshold voltage is 2.64V while the on-state resistance of module is 2.06mΩ when T<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">j</inf> = 175℃ and the corresponding threshold voltage is 1.83V. The switching characteristics of the 750V/800A SiC module are also tested based on high-voltage SiC dynamic test platform. The turn-on energy is 19.5mJ when T<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">j</inf> = 25℃ while the turn-off energy is 33.9mJ. Switching loss of the 750V/800A SiC power MOSFET module is hardly affected by the temperature and the overshoot voltage is quite low. The 750V/800A SiC power MOSFET module demonstrates excellent switching performance and satisfactory temperature stability, thus having obvious advantages in vehicle driver application.

articleTitle: Decoding Visual Fatigue Through Pupil Dynamics
publicationTitle: 2023 20th China International Forum on Solid State Lighting & 2023 9th International Forum on Wide Bandgap Semiconductors (SSLCHINA: IFWS)
abstract: This study delves into the intricate relationship between visual fatigue and pupil parameters, introducing pupil metrics as an innovative approach for visual fatigue assessment. We explored the associations between eight key pupil metrics (including average pupil diameter, pupil fluctuation, pupil adaptation speed, percentage of eye closure, blink duration, blink frequency, Saccade duration, and peak Saccade speed) and subjective ratings of visual fatigue to pinpoint the most indicative metrics for characterizing visual fatigue. Under challenging lighting conditions, we engaged seven volunteers in a visual ergonomics experiment. The outcomes underscored that six of the pupil metrics strongly aligned with the subjective trends of visual fatigue scores. Leveraging the SVM machine learning algorithm and focusing on these six metrics, we achieved a predictive accuracy of 92.86% for visual fatigue, marking a 7.15% improvement over predictions made using all metrics. Overall, our findings substantiate the robustness of these six pupil parameters in evaluating visual fatigue. Furthermore, we crafted a predictive model rooted in these metrics, presenting a potent tool for the detection of visual fatigue.

articleTitle: The Effects of Ambient Illuminance on Display Brightness Perception and Readability
publicationTitle: 2023 20th China International Forum on Solid State Lighting & 2023 9th International Forum on Wide Bandgap Semiconductors (SSLCHINA: IFWS)
abstract: Brightness perception of human visual system (HVS) not only depends on physical luminance but also other factors, such as surrounding illuminance. In this study, to investigate the influence of ambient illuminance on perceived brightness and readability during display usage, a lab study with a within-subjects (N = 12) design was conducted. The subjects evaluated the brightness perception and readability of five display luminance conditions (10, 32, 100, 316, 1000 cd/m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>) under five ambient illuminance conditions (1, 10, 100, 1000, 10000 lx). The results showed that perceived brightness value increased as the display luminance increased. And brightness perception intensity decreased as the ambient illuminance increased. This indicates that the decrease in ambient illumination can appropriately enhance the perceived brightness, which provide a new solution to improve display brightness perception instead of enhancing the maximum display luminance alone. As for the results of readability, it showed that the effect of ambient illuminance on display readability is influenced by display luminance. At low display brightness levels (10, 32 cd/m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>), the recommended illumination range with high readability is 1-10lx. At medium and high display brightness levels (100, 316, 1000 cd/m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>), the recommended illumination range with high readability is 10- 1000lx.

articleTitle: Comparing Electrical Performance of Lateral GaN Schottky Barrier Diode with A-Plane ($11\bar2 0$) and M-Plane ($1\bar1 00$) Nonpolar Sidewall Contact
publicationTitle: 2023 20th China International Forum on Solid State Lighting & 2023 9th International Forum on Wide Bandgap Semiconductors (SSLCHINA: IFWS)
abstract: Regarding the structural innovation of GaN Schottky barrier diodes (SBDs), advanced performance has been attained by lateral GaN SBDs with partial or complete AlGaN barrier layer recesses at anode areas and gated Ohmic metal with double anode structures. In this letter, lateral SBD with a- and m-plane-oriented sidewall contacts were fabricated and characterized. The lateral SBD depended strongly on the nonpolar sidewall-metal plane orientation. The a-plane- oriented SBD devices demonstrated lower turn-on voltage, lower specific on-resistances (R<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">on,sp</inf>), lower sub-threshold slope, and higher current density, and similar on-off ration compared to m-plane SBD sidewall devices. These results indicate that orienting lateral SBD toward the a-plane would allow for better on-state characteristics. The different GaN oriented sidewalls have a similar surface roughness of 0.35nm, confirmed by atomic force microscopy (AFM) measurement. The ideality factor and potential height of the lateral SBDs have extracted from the relationship of lnI-V plots. Regardless of the crystal orientation, the ideal factors of GaN SBDs fall between 1.6 and 1.8, and the Φ<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">b</inf> is 0.65 and 0.69 eV for a-plane and m-plane devices, respectively, It could be speculated that the difference in polarization charges and/or surface oxides of the various crystal planes is what causes the variation in Schottky barrier height.

articleTitle: Optimization of AlGaN-Based Deep Ultraviolet Light Emitting Diodes with Step-Graded Electron Blocking Layer
publicationTitle: 2023 20th China International Forum on Solid State Lighting & 2023 9th International Forum on Wide Bandgap Semiconductors (SSLCHINA: IFWS)
abstract: AlGaN-based deep ultraviolet light-emitting diodes (DUV-LEDs) experience significant electron leakage due to the high mobility of electrons and weak confinement capability of the active region. To mitigate this issue, step- graded (SG) electron blocking layers (EBLs) are proposed. The DUV-LED fabricated by Yan, with an emission wavelength of 284.5 nm, serves as the reference structure. Using the APSYs software, DUV-LEDs with rectangular EBL and SG EBL are simulated. The results show that the SG EBL contributes to the decreased electron leakage in the p-type region, the increased hole injection efficiency, and the enhanced radiation recombination rate of the DUV-LEDs. At an injection current of 60 mA, the output power reaches 9.91 mW, representing an improvement. The SG EBL offers a theoretical framework for addressing electron leakage issues in DUV-LEDs.

articleTitle: Study on P-Well Surface Doping on the Static Characteristics and Avalanche Robustness of Planar SiC-MOSFET
publicationTitle: 2023 20th China International Forum on Solid State Lighting & 2023 9th International Forum on Wide Bandgap Semiconductors (SSLCHINA: IFWS)
abstract: Ion implantation can achieve doping in the P-base region in the fabrication of planar gate silicon carbide (SiC) MOSFET. The doping concentration of the P-base surface region is primarily determined by the dose of the minimum implantation energy during the ion implantation process.
