Therefore, manipulating the dose of minimum implantation energy can regulate the doping concentration on the surface of the P-base. In this study, Sentaurus TCAD was used to investigate the influence of P-base surface doping concentration on the static characteristics and avalanche robustness of SiC MOSFET. The simulation results indicate that an increase in the doping concentration of the P-base surface region leads to a rise in both the threshold voltage and the on-resistance. There is no significant impact on the device's breakdown characteristics if the P-base surface doping exceeds 9.3e16 cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-3</sup>. Furthermore, the result of the unclamped inductive switching (UIS) test simulation revealed that the increase of the surface doping can cause a decline in electron current during the avalanche event, accompanied by a reduction in the duration of the avalanche event, indicating an enhancement of the device's robustness.

articleTitle: A Study on the Hydrogen Effect and Reliability of a Depletion-Mode AlGaN/GaN MISFET Device
publicationTitle: 2023 20th China International Forum on Solid State Lighting & 2023 9th International Forum on Wide Bandgap Semiconductors (SSLCHINA: IFWS)
abstract: Through electrical characteristic testing of the <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\text{AlGaN}/\text{GaN}$</tex> metal insulator semiconductor field effect transistor (MISFET) before and after hydrogen exposure, the results show that: (1) After 500 hours of hydrogen treatment, the threshold voltage of the device shifts from <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$- 16.98{\mathrm{\ V}}$</tex> to <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$11.53{\mathrm{\ V}}$</tex>, with a threshold change of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$5.45{\mathrm{\ V}}$</tex>. It is speculated that the device introduced some defects during the experiment, and these defects can adsorb electrons during testing, resulting in a large positive drift range of the threshold voltage. (2) The transconductance curve before and after the experiment shows that hydrogen treatment increases the peak transconductance of the device, with Gmmax increasing from <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$281\text{mS}/\text{mm}$</tex> to <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$340\text{mS}/\text{mm}$</tex>, an increase of approximately <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$21{\mathrm{\% }}$</tex>. Transconductance represents the gate control ability over the channel. (3) The output characteristics at drain-source voltage <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">${\mathrm{V}}_{\text{DS}}$</tex> from 0 to <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$1{\mathrm{\ V}}$</tex> and gate-source voltage <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">${\mathrm{V}}_{\text{GS}}$</tex> of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$0{\mathrm{\ V}}$</tex> show that under the same bias voltage, hydrogen treatment significantly reduces the leakage current of the device. IDS decreases from <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$9.45{\mathrm{\ A}}$</tex> in the fresh device to <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$7.08{\mathrm{\ A}}$</tex>, a decrease of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$25{\mathrm{\% }}$</tex>. (4) The <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$1/\mathrm{f}$</tex> noise performance is improved, and the device after hydrogen treatment has a lower noise level. Through low-frequency noise (LFN) analysis, the trap density in the <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\text{AlGaN}/\text{GaN}$</tex> MISFET device decreases by approximately one order of magnitude after hydrogen treatment, which leads to a reduction in depletion electrons in the device channel Two-Dimensional Electron Gas (2DEG). The mechanism for the reduction in trap density can be attributed to hydrogen passivation defects at the <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\text{AlGaN}$</tex> surface, <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\text{AlGaN}$</tex> barrier layer, and heterojunction interface. The research results of this article have certain reference value for the design and application of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\text{AlGaN}/\text{GaN}$</tex> MISFET devices.

articleTitle: Plant Growth and Energy Use Efficiency of Purple Basil as Affected by Different Green-Blue Light Ratios
publicationTitle: 2023 20th China International Forum on Solid State Lighting & 2023 9th International Forum on Wide Bandgap Semiconductors (SSLCHINA: IFWS)
abstract: The objective of this experiment was to investigate the effects of different green-blue light ratios (G/B) with 50% percent red light (R, 660nm) on the growth, morphology, light response capacity, and light use efficiency (LUE) of purple basil plants (Ocimum basilicum Linn.). Purple basil seedlings were subjected to seven light quality treatments of RB, RG<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</inf>B<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">7</inf>, RG<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</inf>B<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>, RG<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</inf>B<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</inf>, RG<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>B<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</inf>, RG<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">7</inf>B<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</inf>, and RG for 25 days after transplanting. Growth parameters, photosynthetic parameters, and light utilization efficiency of purple basil plants were measured on day 25 after transplanting. Our results showed that the light response capacity of purple basil decreased when G/B>1, compared with RB, but the height and leaf area still increased under RG<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>B<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</inf> and RG. Moreover, the LUE and fresh weight increased under RG. When G/B≤1, RG<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</inf>B<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> increased shoot fresh weight and leaf area. Based on the above results, RG<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</inf>B<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> and RG can be considered suitable light quality combinations for purple basil's yield and growth rate. These results can provide a technical support for energy-saving and efficient production models of purple basil.

articleTitle: Advanced Vertical Diamond Diodes with Trench Structure towards High Performances
publicationTitle: 2023 20th China International Forum on Solid State Lighting & 2023 9th International Forum on Wide Bandgap Semiconductors (SSLCHINA: IFWS)
abstract: Diamond based diodes are key components for the high- frequency and high-power applications due to its superior material properties. Until now, various advanced edge termination techniques have been adopted to improve the off- state performance, but the trench structure is not investigated extensively for the diamond-based diodes. Herein, three kinds of diamond vertical diodes with trench structure are designed by using the Silvaco simulation. After optimizing the device parameters, the trenched PN junction diode, the sidewall enhanced trenched JBS as well as the step edge termination PND present optimum Baliga's figure of merit. Those results are beneficial to guide the design and fabrication of diamond based PN junction diodes.

articleTitle: Application of Methyl Trichlorosilane in SiC Growth
publicationTitle: 2023 20th China International Forum on Solid State Lighting & 2023 9th International Forum on Wide Bandgap Semiconductors (SSLCHINA: IFWS)
abstract: In this study, the application of CH<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>SiCl<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> (MTS) was investigated in the CVD epitaxial growth of SiC. The diverse growth conditions under different carrier gases, temperatures, and carrier gas flow rates were examined and verified. Based on these findings, a comprehensive set of growth conditions was developed. It was revealed that an optimal temperature of approximately 1500°C is suitable for the use of MTS, and in order to optimize epitaxial growth, a low-flow carrier gas environment should be employed. During various experiments, the deposition of Si elements proved to be a challenging issue. The utilization of higher temperatures and larger gas flow rates often led to the removal of Si elements from the growing epitaxial layer. Therefore, it is crucial to establish appropriate growth conditions in order to achieve efficient and reliable epitaxial growth of SiC using MTS as a precursor.

articleTitle: A Metalens Collimation System for Micro-LED-Based AR Near-Eye Display
publicationTitle: 2023 20th China International Forum on Solid State Lighting & 2023 9th International Forum on Wide Bandgap Semiconductors (SSLCHINA: IFWS)
abstract: We designed a metalens array for collimating light emitted by micro-LED display in Augmented Reality (AR) Near-eye display system. The metalens array realizes transmission efficiency of up to 94.02% and a small focusing spot size of 47.4 μm, with a radius and a long focal length of 0.945 mm and 1 mm, respectively. Compared with traditional collimation system, such a metalens can dramatically reduce the total size of the system. Based on theory and numerical simulations, we proved that the system is compact while maintaining exceptional image quality.

articleTitle: Research of Cell Topology on Characteristics of 750V SiC MOSFETs
publicationTitle: 2023 20th China International Forum on Solid State Lighting & 2023 9th International Forum on Wide Bandgap Semiconductors (SSLCHINA: IFWS)
abstract: This paper analyzes the relationship between channel density and cell size of several common SiC MOSFET cell structures. The 750V60mΩ SiC MOSFET was fabricated based on the improved hexagonal cell. Then the static and dynamic performance tests of the device were completed. Finally, the specific on-resistance of 2.05 mΩ·cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> and the breakdown voltage of 950V are obtained.

articleTitle: Omnidirectional Visible Light Communication and Broadcasting Based on LED Beacon Light
publicationTitle: 2023 20th China International Forum on Solid State Lighting & 2023 9th International Forum on Wide Bandgap Semiconductors (SSLCHINA: IFWS)
abstract: Beacon lights serve as traffic lights for ships, which are essential devices for nighttime navigation in maritime transportation. In addition to illumination, LED beacon signaling lights have the potentials to serve as transmitters for visible light communication (VLC), enabling message broadcasting for smart navigation. In this work, we demonstrate an omnidirectional visible light communication system for long-distance data transmission using commercially available beacon light. A photomultiplier tube (PMT) based receiver has been developed to enable a long-range communication. Experimental results suggest that such system is capable to broadcast up to 5 kilometers with a data rate of 1600 bps. The feasibility of integrating visible light communication into navigation lighting infrastructure has been validated.

articleTitle: AlGaN/AlN/GaN High Electron Mobility Transistor Electromagnetic Physical Model: Simulation and Measurement
publicationTitle: 2023 20th China International Forum on Solid State Lighting & 2023 9th International Forum on Wide Bandgap Semiconductors (SSLCHINA: IFWS)
abstract: Based on the Silvaco TCAD-ATLAS platform, an electromagnetic physical model of GaN HEMT devices was built. The DC and RF characteristics of GaN HEMT simulation and measurement are compared. The error between the physical model simulation data of output characteristics and transfer characteristics and WAT (Wafer Acceptance Test) measurement data is less than 10%. The concentration of two-dimensional electron gas(2DEG) in the channel region was obtained by integration was roughly 1e13cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−2</sup>. The error between the physical model simulation data of RF characteristics and de-embedding data is less than 15%. This is of guiding significance for improving the key indicators of GaN HEMT devices and accelerating the iterative process.

articleTitle: Implementation of 1200V SiC MOSFET with 20% Lower On-Resistance by Designing the Interrupted P+ Region
publicationTitle: 2023 20th China International Forum on Solid State Lighting & 2023 9th International Forum on Wide Bandgap Semiconductors (SSLCHINA: IFWS)
abstract: Although the SiC MOSFETs with square or hexagonal designed cells have a small on-resistance, the electric fields of sharp corners within these designed cells lead to the reduction of blocking voltage. The SiC MOSFETs with linear cells can maintain the blocking voltage, while the relatively large cell usually increases the on-resistance and power consumption. In this article, we designed and fabricated the SiC MOSFETs with linear cells and interrupted linear cells whose N<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">+</sup> region is embedded with the P<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">+</sup> region. Then we compare their characteristics of specific on-resistance, forward characteristic, and blocking voltage, and report the demonstration of a high-voltage 4H-silicon carbide (SiC) MOSFETs with 20% losses of on-resistance by interrupting the N<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">+</sup> region with P<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">+</sup> region. We provide a new linear cell design that can effectively reduce the on-resistance of 1200 V SiC MOSFET and maintain the blocking voltage.

articleTitle: Total Ionizing Effects on Static Characteristics of 1200V SiC MOSFET Power Devices with Planar and Trench Structures
publicationTitle: 2023 20th China International Forum on Solid State Lighting & 2023 9th International Forum on Wide Bandgap Semiconductors (SSLCHINA: IFWS)
abstract: With the rapid development of the aviation industry, an increasing number of metal oxide semiconductor field effect transistors (MOSFETs) are being used in aerospace equipment. The total ionizing dose (TID) test has been developed for silicon power devices to evaluate their space usage capabilities. To evaluate the TID tolerance of silicon carbide (SiC) devices, two 1200V SiC MOSFET power devices with planar and trench structures were aged gamma irradiation environment, and the degradation of static properties, such as the transfer characteristics, output characteristics, and breakdown voltage were analyzed. The comparison of TID effects was made between planar and trench MOSFETs under gate bias (i.e., <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mathrm{V}_{\text{gs}} = 18$</tex>V and <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mathrm{V}_{\text{ds}} = 0$</tex>V) and zero bias (<tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mathrm{V}_{\text{gs}} = 0$</tex>V and <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mathrm{V}_{\text{ds}} = 18$</tex>V) conditions. The experimental results show that: (1) The trench MOSFET was more sensitive to TID effects, due to its unique structure and thick gate oxide. (2) The severity of TID effect under gate bias was mainly caused by the electric field within the gate oxide, which exacerbated the TID effect as compared to zero bias. (3) The degradation mechanisms of TID effect with increasing dose is illustrated, and several radiation hardening methods are proposed, including thinning the gate oxide, improving the quality of the gate oxide, and using insulating dielectrics with a wider bandgap instead of SiO2. Therefore, this work will be helpful to the explanation and radiation hardening of 1200V SiC MOSFET power devices under TID effects.

articleTitle: 4H-SiC Floating Island JBS with Multi-Layer Floating Field Ring Termination
publicationTitle: 2023 20th China International Forum on Solid State Lighting & 2023 9th International Forum on Wide Bandgap Semiconductors (SSLCHINA: IFWS)
abstract: The FI structure can break the theoretical 1-D limit of the SiC power semiconductor. In this paper, the 4H-SiC Floating Island Junction Barrier Schottky (FIJBS) diodes with Multi- layer Floating Field Ring (MFFR) termination are fabricated, characterized, simulated, and analyzed. The specific ON- resistance of the FIJBS decreases as the island spacing increases, and increases as the temperature increases. The breakdown voltage decreases and the leakage current increases, as the island spacing increases. The MFFR termination is used to terminate the active region of the FIJBS. The breakdown voltage first increases and then saturates with increasing the terminal ring number. And it also first increases and then saturated with the increasing terminal first ring spacing. The optimized MFFR termination can distribute the electric field evenly across the device, so as to withstand a high reverse voltage. The FIJBS with MFFR termination is also proved to have a good tolerance to the alignment deviation.

articleTitle: A Novel Voltage-Controlled Oscillator Suitable for Silicon-Based Microdisplay Driver Clock
publicationTitle: 2023 20th China International Forum on Solid State Lighting & 2023 9th International Forum on Wide Bandgap Semiconductors (SSLCHINA: IFWS)
abstract: In order to provide silicon microdisplay drivers a wide tuning range clock and solve the problem that the tuning range of VCO is not wide enough, a wide tuning range multi-band feedforward differential delay cell based on CMOS inverter is proposed in this paper. The cell achieves the wide-tuned multi-band effect by adjusting the control voltage (VCTRL) and the control voltage sequence bits. In the HLMC 55LP process, the differential VCO can be adjusted from 3.92GHz to 8.63GHz to achieve a wide tuning range of multi-band output with a FOM of −157.02dBc/Hz.

articleTitle: Multi-Distribution Learning Network Empowers the Transmission of Multi-Level Grayscale Information Through Multimode Fiber Optic Communication System.
publicationTitle: 2023 20th China International Forum on Solid State Lighting & 2023 9th International Forum on Wide Bandgap Semiconductors (SSLCHINA: IFWS)
abstract: We present a multi-distributed learning network framework for accurate grayscale image transmission over multimode optical fiber communication system. We develop a method for deconstructing the decision layer that allows for high-precision reconstruction of low-order grayscale images in 1km-meter multimode fiber optic communication system.

articleTitle: Half-FinFET Based on Double-Channel AlGaN/GaN Heterostructure
publicationTitle: 2023 20th China International Forum on Solid State Lighting & 2023 9th International Forum on Wide Bandgap Semiconductors (SSLCHINA: IFWS)
abstract: A novel Half-FinFET based on double-channel AlGaN/GaN heterostructure was developed for applications requiring high linearity. The transfer characteristics of the device are simulated by TCAD simulation software. The enhancement in current density and linearity characteristics has been achieved by optimizing the gate configuration of the device. The half-fin-type gate of the device modulates the transconductance characteristics. Therefore, the linearity characteristics can be significantly improved by optimizing the half-fin configuration.

articleTitle: Study on the Influence of FS Region on the Conduction Characteristics of GaN based RC-IGBT
publicationTitle: 2023 20th China International Forum on Solid State Lighting & 2023 9th International Forum on Wide Bandgap Semiconductors (SSLCHINA: IFWS)
abstract: The effect of doping concentration and thickness of field stop (FS) region on the characteristics of GaN based Reverse Conduction Insulated Gate Bipolar Transistor (RC-IGBT) is studied. By comparing the forward and reverse conduction characteristics of the device when the doping concentration in the FS region is 5e16cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−3</sup>, 8e16cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−3</sup>, 1e17cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−3</sup>, 2e17cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−3</sup>, 3e17cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−3</sup>, 5e17 cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−3</sup>, it can be seen that the higher the doping concentration in the FS region, the larger the snapback point voltage of RC-IGBT, which means that the more difficult it is to convert between modes; However, the latch-up voltage increases, which means that the device is less prone to latch- up, and the reverse conduction ability is better. By comparing the forward and reverse conduction characteristics of the device when the thickness of the FS region is 0.2μm, 0.3μm, 0.4μm, 0.5μm, 0.6μm, 0.7μm, it can be seen that the thicker the FS region is, the snapback point voltage of the device increases slightly, but the latch-up voltage increases obviously, and the reverse conduction ability is almost unchanged.

articleTitle: An Approach to GaN HEMT Modeling Based on Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 20th China International Forum on Solid State Lighting & 2023 9th International Forum on Wide Bandgap Semiconductors (SSLCHINA: IFWS)
abstract: In this paper, we used Angelov model to fit large signal drain-source current I<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">ds</inf> of six GaN HEMT devices with different gate widths and gate lengths, and used Matlab platform to build Genetic Algorithm (GA) to extract parameters. The results showed that the fitting accuracy was as high as 99.6% after using GA. The algorithm has the characteristics of fast convergence speed, high accuracy and strong reusability. At the same time, the parameter extraction can be completed in batches with the assistance of Matlab platform, which greatly improves the modeling efficiency.

articleTitle: Research on Stability of H-Terminated Diamond MESFET
publicationTitle: 2023 20th China International Forum on Solid State Lighting & 2023 9th International Forum on Wide Bandgap Semiconductors (SSLCHINA: IFWS)
abstract: In this paper, metal–semiconductor field effect transistor devices based on hydrogen-terminated diamond were fabricated, and the output stability of the devices under cyclic testing and low-temperature conditions was investigated. Under cyclic testing, the maximum output current of the device decreased by approximately 4.3%, and the maximum shift in the transfer curve was 0.12V. At low temperatures, the device also exhibited relatively good stability, with a maximum shift in the transfer curve of 0.2V.

articleTitle: Ocular Comfort Enhancement in Improved Screen Brightness with Dynamic Feature
publicationTitle: 2023 20th China International Forum on Solid State Lighting & 2023 9th International Forum on Wide Bandgap Semiconductors (SSLCHINA: IFWS)
abstract: Display technology benefits users yet meanwhile induces increasing ocular discomforts, and improper brightness is extensively recognized as a primary cause. To figure out optimized screen brightness in different ambient illuminances, we performed human factor experiments in the current study with three different-brightness smartphones in 300lux and 500lux ambient illuminance respectively. We compared ocular accommodation variations and VICO indexes of 30 participants who performed visual tasks with the three smartphones, and found the automatic smartphone brightness in the market was lower than the proper brightness for human eyes, and time-variant brightness with proper brightness level could further decrease ocular discomfort. We implied that smartphone automatic brightness level should match ambient lighting illuminance. In addition, time-variant brightness with proper level is better than constant for visual health.

articleTitle: Bright Deep Ultraviolet Luminescence from Semipolar AlGaN Multiple Quantum Wells Grown on Dislocation-Free Crystal Grains
publicationTitle: 2023 20th China International Forum on Solid State Lighting & 2023 9th International Forum on Wide Bandgap Semiconductors (SSLCHINA: IFWS)
abstract: High-quality AlGaN multiple quantum wells (MQWs) were fabricated successfully on semipolar facets of the crystal grains by metal-organic vapor phase epitaxy. Utilizing the advantage of epitaxial lateral overgrowth, dislocation-free can be achieved on the wing region of the crystal grain with semipolar facets. Distinct cathodoluminescence images were observed in the two semipolar MQWs. The step bunching facets contain a high density of macrosteps with Ga-rich ribbons that result in wire-like emission along the steps. By contrast, the flat semipolar MQWs present more uniform emission behaviours. Bright luminescence is observed from both dislocation-free semipolar MQWs. Compared to the regular c-plane planar MQWs, the emission from semipolar MQWs is 1.26 and 4.6 times higher at low and room temperature conditions, respectively. This work sheds new light on the development of high-performance semipolar AlGaN-based deep ultraviolet light-emitting diodes.

articleTitle: Perceivable Thresholds for Distinguishing Different CCTs: A Preliminary Study
publicationTitle: 2023 20th China International Forum on Solid State Lighting & 2023 9th International Forum on Wide Bandgap Semiconductors (SSLCHINA: IFWS)
abstract: The influence of correlated color temperature (CCT) on the color quality of light sources has been extensively investigated. However, the limitations and nonuniformity associated with the CCT parameter have hindered its effectiveness in lighting designs and applications. To explore the color perception and visual memory of light sources with varying CCT values, three preliminary experiments based on Signal Detection Theory (SDT) methods were conducted. The discrepancies between observers' subjective judgments and the actual CCT of the light source (ΔCCT), along with sensitivity (d') and decision criterion (c), were calculated and analyzed. The results revealed that observers' color memory for light sources with specific CCT values was not accurate and significantly influenced by the observed light source's color temperature. Furthermore, disparities between high CCT group and low CCT group were also observed. The perceptible thresholds for distinguishing different CCTs were determined by both absolute ΔCCT value as well as sensitivity measure. Methodology advice was provided for future lighting research and applications in which CCT parameter was applied.

articleTitle: A Novel Monolithic Integration Of HEMT And Micro-LED Performing As A Photodetector
publicationTitle: 2023 20th China International Forum on Solid State Lighting & 2023 9th International Forum on Wide Bandgap Semiconductors (SSLCHINA: IFWS)
abstract: Micro light-emitting diode (LED (LED) is considered as a promising next-generation display technology, owing to its superior performances such as high efficiency and fast response. Although GaN-based Micro-LED is mainly used as a light source, it can be utilized as a photodetector as well due to its crystal structure and material properties. This dual function enables Micro-LED to realize the monolithic integration of light source and photodetector, making it advantageous in visible light communication (VLC) applications. In this paper, a new monolithic integrated device of GaN-based high electron mobility transistor (HEMT) and Micro-LED is proposed by merging the features of HEMT and LED epitaxy without selective epitaxial growth, to integrate driving transistor and Micro- led on the same substrate. In this paper, the integrated HEMT-LED structure was tested as an optical detector under the wavelength of 365nm, 395nm and 425nm and the optical current at different light intensities. The response rate and bright/dark current ratio were derived. At the wavelength of 365 nm, the light intensity reaches its maximum value of 4.06 × 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-4</sup> mW/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>, and a peak responsivity of 7000 A/W is obtained. This work provides a promising solution for the future exploration of the device structure design of monolithic integration of light source and optical detector in VLC systems.

articleTitle: Development of β-Ga2O3 Thermal Management: A Review
publicationTitle: 2023 20th China International Forum on Solid State Lighting & 2023 9th International Forum on Wide Bandgap Semiconductors (SSLCHINA: IFWS)
abstract: The semiconductor material, beta-phase gallium oxide (β-Ga<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>), is becoming increasingly popular due to its ultrawide bandgap and excellent electrical performance. However, its low thermal conductivity has been proven by first principle calculation with ShengBTE and experimental measurements with time-domain thermos reflectance, and been identified as a significant challenge in the development of next-generation devices. To address the issue, the integration of β-Ga<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> with high thermally conductive materials can a be good solution. Different simulation packages prove that diamond, AlN, and 4H-SiC can be good candidate materials. To what extent the thermal conductivity of β-Ga<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> can be improved depends on the integration technique. Ion-cutting technique and fusion bonding technique are effective methods to get high-quality β- Ga<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>/4H-SiC heterostructure which transfers heat more efficiently. β-Ga<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>/4H-SiC SBD and MOSFET based on these techniques show better capability of heat dissipation. Mechanical exfoliation, chemical vapor deposition, and atomic layer deposition are used to create β-Ga<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>/diamond, but more research is necessary to improve the quality of the heterostructure and its thermal conductivity. In terms of β- Ga<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> devices, vertical device structure is better for dissipating heat, and double-sided cooling strategy is recommended. Besides, β-Ga<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>/metal interfaces affect thermal management as well, and it's found that Cr is suitable for ohmic contact and Ni fits for schottky contact to facilitate the flow of heat. Above all, this review is expected to provide researchers with recent progress in β-Ga<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> thermal management and inspire more aspiration.

articleTitle: A Single-stage Bridgeless Cuk Resonant LED Driver using Silicon Carbide Power Device
publicationTitle: 2023 20th China International Forum on Solid State Lighting & 2023 9th International Forum on Wide Bandgap Semiconductors (SSLCHINA: IFWS)
abstract: In application of small and medium power LED lighting, the traditional two-stage LED driver exists in large size, two sets of control circuits and traditional Cuk PFC circuit rectifier bridge conduction loss and other issues. A single-stage LED driver without electrolytic capacitor integrated by a bridgeless Cuk PFC circuit and a DC-DC LLC circuit using silicon carbide power device is proposed, which reduces conduction loss, MOS tube ZVS, and a set of control circuits. Finally, a <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$200{\mathrm{\ W}}$</tex> experimental prototype was designed on the basis of the simulation. In the input voltage range of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$185 \sim 265\text{Vrms}$</tex>, the PF values of the prototype were obtained to be higher than 0.990, and the THDs were obtained to be less than 15%. at the input voltage of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$185\text{Vrms}$</tex>, the PFs and THDs were obtained to be respectively 0.994 and <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$11.4{\mathrm{\% }}$</tex>. Under full load conditions, the prototype efficiency was obtained up to <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$92.39{\mathrm{\% }}$</tex> at <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$205{\mathrm{\ V}}r{\mathrm{\ ms}}$</tex> input. The effectiveness of the proposed driver is verified by simulation and experimental results.

articleTitle: A Transient Response Control Strategy with Power Compensation for GaN-based Buck-Boost LLC Converters
publicationTitle: 2023 20th China International Forum on Solid State Lighting & 2023 9th International Forum on Wide Bandgap Semiconductors (SSLCHINA: IFWS)
abstract: Buck-boost LLC converter (BBLLC) can maintain both high efficiency and wide input voltage range, simultaneously. However, the dynamic performance of BBLLC degrades due to the introducing of an additional stage. To solve this problem, an improved transient response control based on power compensation for BBLLC is proposed. This strategy aims to compensates the lack or excess energy in the output capacitor during load switching. The digital implementation of energy calculation and regulation is also discussed. Compared with the conventional control strategy, the energy lost in the capacitor is calculated by output voltage deviation instead of the capacitor current to avoid the sampling problem. The proposed strategy can be applied to the high frequency converter with low-cost microcontroller (MCU). Finally, experimental results are demonstrated on a 1MHz BBLLC converter with a 72MHz MCU.

articleTitle: JBS Device Design and Post-Etch Surface Repair Process Research
publicationTitle: 2023 20th China International Forum on Solid State Lighting & 2023 9th International Forum on Wide Bandgap Semiconductors (SSLCHINA: IFWS)
abstract: GaN quasi-vertical power devices are of high research value because of their ability to introduce current and electric field into the device body, as well as their ability to realize large-area process production at low cost. In this paper, a GaN-based Junction Barrier Schottky diode (JBS) is designed. Firstly, the relationship between the doping concentration of P<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">+</sup>-GaN layer, the doping concentration of N<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-</sup>-GaN layer, reverse voltage and depletion layer width of the JBS device is theoretically calculated, and then the etching of the secondary epitaxial window as well as the surface restoration process are investigated. The P<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">+</sup>-GaN layer was etched using photoresist mask and SiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> mask, and the etched step was treated with TMAH solution and KOH solution. The SEM (Scanning Electron Microscope) test results show that the GaN stage etching with SiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> as a mask and the treatment of the stage with TMAH solution is flatter and smoother, which is more favorable for the subsequent secondary epitaxy process. Combining the above results, the epitaxial parameters of the JBS device are designed as follows: the concentration of the P<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">+</sup>-GaN layer is 1×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">17</sup> cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-3</sup>, and the doping concentration of the N<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-</sup>-GaN layer is 2×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">16</sup> cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-3</sup>; among the processes, SiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> is used as a mask for the GaN step etching, and TMAH solution is used to repair the etched surface.

articleTitle: Impact of Typical SiC Epilayer Defects on the Yield and Performance of 4H-SiC JBS Diodes
publicationTitle: 2023 20th China International Forum on Solid State Lighting & 2023 9th International Forum on Wide Bandgap Semiconductors (SSLCHINA: IFWS)
abstract: The yield and performance of 1.2-kV 4H-SiC junction barrier Schottky diode were investigated on two complete wafers, taking into account pre-identified defects. The defects present on the entire wafer were accurately captured and mapped using commercial laser-based inspection tools, employing an iterative recipe analysis approach. All the diodes were characterized using I-V measurement with the Keysight B1505 system. By comparing the electric properties yield mapping of JBS diodes with the specific defects mapping, both killer and non-killer defects were determined through actual case analysis. Particularly, the micropipes that penetrate the entire epitaxial layer and the triangular defects caused by downfall or particles have a significant impact on the block voltage properties of the JBS diodes.

articleTitle: A Novel and Simple Way of Characterizing Gate Oxide Reliability of SiC MOSFETs
publicationTitle: 2023 20th China International Forum on Solid State Lighting & 2023 9th International Forum on Wide Bandgap Semiconductors (SSLCHINA: IFWS)
abstract: The penetration pace of SiC devices in power conversions cannot be quickened without thorough investigation on reliability of the new semiconductors. The issue of threshold voltage drifting, resulting from gate oxide defects, is considered as a major concern. While HTGB testing is used as a standard approach for assessing and screening SiC MOSFETs, proper technique is needed to simultaneously monitoring and characterizing status of the devices. In this paper, a simple way of performing HTGB test and, at the same time, characterizing threshold voltage drifting of SiC MOSFETs with online and instant data collecting is proposed. Experimental setup was built to prove and demonstrate the new approach.

articleTitle: Effective Integration of Suspended Membrane Light-Emitting Diode with E-Mode MOSFET on GaN-on-Si LED Epi Wafer
publicationTitle: 2023 20th China International Forum on Solid State Lighting & 2023 9th International Forum on Wide Bandgap Semiconductors (SSLCHINA: IFWS)
abstract: We reported the effective integration of a suspended membrane GaN light-emitting diode (LED) and an enhancement-mode (E-mode) metal oxide semiconductor field effect transistor (MOSFET) on a GaN-on-Si LED epitaxial (epi) wafer. Without additional epitaxial regrowth, the e-mode MOSFET was designed and fabricated on the LED epi layer and the drain of MOSFET was connected to the cathode of the LED by using the n-doping GaN material. The gate-recess structure was adopted to improve the output current of the MOSFET. With the back-thinning technique, the suspended membrane LED was designed to enhance the light emission. The integrated MOSFET showed a threshold of 3.4 V and a maximum output current of 0.26 mA. The MOSFET could effectively control the output current, light output power (LOP), and the peak value of light intensity of the integrated MOSFET-LED device. This integration approach gives a promising option for visible light communication system.

articleTitle: Transient Thermodynamic Simulation of Micro LED Array Bonding
publicationTitle: 2023 20th China International Forum on Solid State Lighting & 2023 9th International Forum on Wide Bandgap Semiconductors (SSLCHINA: IFWS)
abstract: Micro LED display technology is considered to be the next generation of display technology and finds widespread applications in displays and visible light communication. Key cooperation plays a crucial role in achieving electrical interconnections for Micro LED, which significantly impact their luminous quality and reliability. This study aims to analyze the stress-strain evolution during the bonding process of Micro LED arrays with cylindrical and spherical In bumps using COMSOL. The results demonstrate that the displacement of the bumps after bonding decreases by up to 97% compared to the displacement observed during the temperature-holding phase. Furthermore, the stresses during the temperature rise and fall stages approximately exhibit a linear relationship with temperature, and residual stresses exist after bonding. Additionally, residual stresses remain present after bonding. This study provides theoretical guidance for optimizing the bonding process of Micro LED and further exploration for the commercialization of Micro LED.

articleTitle: Design and Simulation Analysis of GaN-Based Resonant Cavity Micro-LED for Display Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 20th China International Forum on Solid State Lighting & 2023 9th International Forum on Wide Bandgap Semiconductors (SSLCHINA: IFWS)
abstract: Micro-LED has the advantages of self-illumination, high efficiency, high response frequency, low power consumption, high integration, high stability, etc., and has a wide range of application prospects in smart wear, AR/VR display, 3D display and other scenarios. Due to the inconsistent light output requirements of different display scenarios, Micro-LED need to be combined with optical structures for luminous control. Traditional miniature LED devices emit a Lambertian distribution, requiring multiple optics to be stacked in the display, resulting in a large and inefficient system with limited viewing area and viewpoint. We propose and study a single-chip Micro-LED with integrated resonator (RC Micro-LED), RC Micro-LED has great potential in high light efficiency, wide viewing angle and high definition contrast display. However, the current design and research of resonator miniature light-emitting diodes have not yet elucidated the influence mechanism of resonator geometric parameter changes on the regulation of device optical output. In this paper, the finite differential time domain (FDTD) method is used to study the influence of Micro-LED with resonator structure on the optical output regulation of the device compared with the traditional MicroLED without resonator structure, and the influence of changing the resonator geometric parameters (including the thickness of the resonator and the shape of the cross-section) on the optical output control of the device is studied. This study provides guidance for the design and manufacture of GaN resonator Micro-LED and promotes their application in displays.

articleTitle: 4H-SiC Trench MOSFET with Half-Surrounded Gate for Improved Gate Oxide Reliability
publicationTitle: 2023 20th China International Forum on Solid State Lighting & 2023 9th International Forum on Wide Bandgap Semiconductors (SSLCHINA: IFWS)
abstract: In this work, a novel silicon carbide (SiC) trench metal- oxide-semiconductor field transistor (MOSFET) with half- surrounded gate (HSG-TMOS) is proposed and its performance is studied via numerical simulation with Silvaco TCAD. The gate trench of the HSG-TMOS is half surrounded by two p-type epitaxial layers. The lightly doped Pbase region can alleviate the conduction characteristic degradation caused by the L-shaped current channel while the heavily doped p- type shield region (P+SLD) shows great shielding effect in the blocking state. Therefore, the blocking characteristic is significantly improved and the peak electric field in the gate oxide (E<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">ox,peak</inf>) is relieved. Simulation results show that compared with the trench MOSFET with a P+SLD under the gate trench (GP-TMOS), the breakdown voltage (BV) and Baliga's figure of merit (BFOM) of the HSG-TMOS increases by 46.0% and 14.9%, respectively. The E<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">ox,peak</inf> at the drain bias of 1200V decreases from 2.75MV/cm for the GP-TMOS to 1.90MV/cm for the HSG-TMOS. It decreases by 30.9%, which improves the gate oxide reliability, significantly. In addition, the switching power loss of the HSG-TMOS is 48.6% lower than that of the GP-TMOS due to the reduced specific capacitance. Moreover, the influence of the key parameters on the HSG-TMOS is discussed.

articleTitle: Research on the Comprehensive Impact of Visual Perception by Lighting and Glass of Display Cabinet in Art Museum
publicationTitle: 2023 20th China International Forum on Solid State Lighting & 2023 9th International Forum on Wide Bandgap Semiconductors (SSLCHINA: IFWS)
abstract: Two psychophysical experiments have been conducted to investigate the effect of lighting and material of cabinet's mask in art museum. Over 40 observers were asked to evaluate lacquerware under different light sources of 3000K and 4000K matching glass or plastic mask in experiment 1. The subjective evaluation of individual exhibits and overall display area were scaled. While in experiment 2, color discrimination under different materials of mask were investigated. The results indicate the mask is the most significant element that influence the visual perception. Observers preferred light source of 4000K under glass mask while lighting of higher illuminance with 3000K under plastic mask. In addition, the mask material showed significant effect on color discrimination and glass mask perform better than plastic mask.

articleTitle: Research on Failure Detection Method for SiC and GaN Power Devices Based on Frequency Domain Impedance Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 20th China International Forum on Solid State Lighting & 2023 9th International Forum on Wide Bandgap Semiconductors (SSLCHINA: IFWS)
abstract: The third–generation power semiconductor devices, represented by SiC/GaN materials, undergo long-term operation under complex high-frequency conditions and need to withstand continuous high thermal stress dv/dt, di/dt impacts, which can lead to reliability issues. Common failure types in welded power devices include bond wire fault, solder layers degradation, and Al–pad metallization reconstruction. Moreover, the reliability of the gate oxide layer is an important failure risk for SiC/GaN power devices. In this paper, the correlation between impedance parameters (parasitic inductance, parasitic resistance) and the physical failure of power devices is discovered using Ansys–Q3D frequency domain simulation. By establishing a two–port network measurement system, the power device's frequency domain impedance curves are extracted. Degradation experiments are designed based on typical failure modes, and a mapping model between frequency domain impedance parameters of power devices and physical failures is established using the experimental results. The proposed approach is an effective quality screening technology for high–frequency SiC/GaN power devices without requiring power on treatment.

articleTitle: Simulation Study of p-GaN Gate HEMTs With Dielectric Interlayer
publicationTitle: 2023 20th China International Forum on Solid State Lighting & 2023 9th International Forum on Wide Bandgap Semiconductors (SSLCHINA: IFWS)
abstract: In this work, we present a p-GaN gate HEMT with a thin dielectric interlayer and investigate the impacts of interlayer on the performances of p-GaN gate HEMTs using Silvaco TCAD. The transfer characteristics and gate forward breakdown characteristics are simulated, and the results show that devices with interlayers exhibit a smaller gate leakage and a much higher gate forward breakdown voltage (V<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">G-BD</inf>) compared to the conventional p-GaN gate HEMT. The V<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">G-BD</inf> of devices with 3 nm Al<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>, HfO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> and SiN interlayers represent 145%, 79% and 97% increase (@ I<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">G</inf> = 1μA/mm), respectively.

articleTitle: Study of Poly-Si Gate Annealing on the Electrical Characteristics of 1200 V 4H-SiC MOSFETs
publicationTitle: 2023 20th China International Forum on Solid State Lighting & 2023 9th International Forum on Wide Bandgap Semiconductors (SSLCHINA: IFWS)
abstract: 1200 V 4H-SiC MOSFETs were successfully fabricated on 6-inch wafers with an on-resistance of 34 mΩ. Following 60 min annealing at 900°C of the phosphorus-implanted poly- Si gate, the on-resistance of the SiC MOSFET decreases, but the threshold voltage and breakdown voltage of the device also decrease. Additionally, CV testing revealed a reduction in interface state density after poly-Si gate annealing. Through TCAD simulations, we observed that the decrease in interface state density can be attributed to the diffusion of phosphorus atoms into the SiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>/SiC interface.

articleTitle: Preparation of Ultrafine Copper Powder by Reduction of Cupric Oxide with Ascorbic Acid
publicationTitle: 2023 20th China International Forum on Solid State Lighting & 2023 9th International Forum on Wide Bandgap Semiconductors (SSLCHINA: IFWS)
abstract: Ultrafine copper powder with uniform particle size and good dispersion was prepared in aqueous solution using copper oxide as precursor, ascorbic acid as reducing agent, polyvinyl pyrrolidone as dispersing agent by liquid phase reduction. The average particle size of the obtained copper powder was 1.78 μm and the tapped density was 4.07 g /cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>. The effects of pH and polyvinyl pyrrolidone concentration on the morphology and particle size of ultrafine copper powder were studied.

articleTitle: 4H-SiC Trench-Gate MOSFET with a Step-Shaped Deep P+ Source Area and an Extra n-Type Shielding Area
publicationTitle: 2023 20th China International Forum on Solid State Lighting & 2023 9th International Forum on Wide Bandgap Semiconductors (SSLCHINA: IFWS)
abstract: This paper brought up a novel 4H-SiC U-shaped trench- gate MOSFET to increase the devices’ performance. The new-structured device featured a step-shaped bottom corner in its P+ source area and an extra n-type shielding area. To verify its performance, a series of the simulation was operated using Silvaco TCAD. The step-shaped corner showed a 36% increase in breakdown voltage. Meanwhile, the n-type shielding area could reduce the on-resistance by 36%. As a result, the novel device could obtain a 71% enhancement in the figure of merit (FOM).

articleTitle: Effect of mixed PN on the electrical characteristics of 1200V/20A 4H-SiC MPS diodes
publicationTitle: 2023 20th China International Forum on Solid State Lighting & 2023 9th International Forum on Wide Bandgap Semiconductors (SSLCHINA: IFWS)
abstract: The effect of mixed PN on the forward current of 1200V 4H-SiC MPS diodes was revealed. The experimental results show that the mixed PN-MPS diodes can reduce the forward voltage. The possible reasons were analyzed based on simulation calculations and theoretical explanations. Compared with the JBS diodes, when the forward voltage is applied, the space charge region of the mixed PN-MPS diodes is reduced by 0.4 μm and the Schottky effective area is imperceptibly increased by 0.4 μm. The imperceptible increase of the Schottky area will decrease the on-resistance and increase the forward current. At the same time, the reverse characteristics are not affected. The test results of forward and reverse characteristics were consistent with the simulation results.

articleTitle: Optimized design of single trench termination combined with P-type buried layers for power MOSFETs
publicationTitle: 2023 20th China International Forum on Solid State Lighting & 2023 9th International Forum on Wide Bandgap Semiconductors (SSLCHINA: IFWS)
abstract: In this study, we conducted simulations and optimizations for the trench termination parameters of a power MOSFET chip. Unlike conventional atlas modeling, we employed the Athena process simulator to execute the real power MOSFET flow process. This led to the formation of a termination with high reliability following grid optimization and atlas electrical calculations. The breakdown voltage of the termination was determined to be 1388 V, achieved with a mere 140 µm length. Our article provides a detailed exploration of the optimization process.

articleTitle: Comparison of GaN HEMT Thermal Resistance Measurement Method Between Uniform Pulse Method and Modulation Method
publicationTitle: 2023 20th China International Forum on Solid State Lighting & 2023 9th International Forum on Wide Bandgap Semiconductors (SSLCHINA: IFWS)
abstract: This paper mainly introduces the validation and comparison of two GaN HEMT device thermal resistance characterization methods: the uniform pulse method and the modulation method. The research group simulated the response of the two methods to different error sources on a computer, examined their feasibility, and explored their robustness towards different error sources. In this paper, the basic principles of the two error sources were selected according to the packaging temperature fluctuations and measurement delay cooling as error sources. The simulation results show that the uniform pulse method is more strongly affected by errors caused by packaging temperature fluctuations, while the modulation method can effectively resist errors caused by this factor. Meanwhile, both measurement methods failed to resist the measurement delay error, showing significant error increases in the delay duration scan from 0-10% off duration of maximum delay. In Addition, the modulation factor of the modulation method showcases an impact on the error ratio under the same delay time in the simulation.

articleTitle: A Self-Adjustable Blanking Time Short Circuit Protection Circuit for SiC Power MOSFETs
publicationTitle: 2023 20th China International Forum on Solid State Lighting & 2023 9th International Forum on Wide Bandgap Semiconductors (SSLCHINA: IFWS)
abstract: This paper proposed a self-adjustable blanking time short circuit protection circuit for SiC power MOSFETs. This circuit consists of a variable blanking time module and a short circuit (SC) detection module. It can automatically set the detection delay for hard switching fault (HSF) and respond quickly to shut down the SiC MOSFET under SC situations. The proposed SC protection circuit does not require a blanking capacitor and can be integrated into the gate driver IC. The proposed SC protection circuit is designed using X-FAB's 0.35 µm BCD technology and is verified using Spectre simulations. HSF and fault under load (FUL) conditions can be quickly detected by the proposed SC protection circuit. With a 600 V bus, the default detection delay is 133 ns for the HSF occurring in the first switching cycle. The detection delay can be varied from 76 to 111 ns by changing the gate resistance <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$R_{G}$</tex> from 5 to 25 Ω for the subsequent occurrence of HSF. The detection delay for FUL is 52 ns, and it is not affected by <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$R_{G}$</tex>.

articleTitle: Voltage Balancing Method for Series-Connected SiC MOSFETs Under No Load Condition
publicationTitle: 2023 20th China International Forum on Solid State Lighting & 2023 9th International Forum on Wide Bandgap Semiconductors (SSLCHINA: IFWS)
abstract: Voltage Source Converters (VSCs) serve as vital interfaces between DC and AC systems, playing a pivotal role in medium DC distribution systems. VSCs using series- connected SiC MOSFETs can increase power density and reduce footprints, which is significant for urban gird applications. To balance the voltages of series-connected SiC MOSFETs, an active clamping module (ACM), including an auxiliary switch and a capacitor, is paralleled with each device. The device voltages are balanced as long as ACM capacitor voltages are balanced. A balancing control method is proposed to balance ACM capacitor voltages under no-load condition: select half of the ACMs in two phase legs and recycle the energy back to DC bus. By assigning a pulsing gate signal to ACMs with higher voltages in dead time, the voltage balance can be achieved. There are two manners of selecting ACMs based on the sorting method: voltage sorting in each arm separately and sorting in both arms together. A VSC built with 4 series-connected SiC MOSFETs is tested under no load condition and the devices are well balanced.

articleTitle: A L-Band 1003-W AlGaN/GaN HEMT Power Amplifier for Operation at 100V Bias
publicationTitle: 2023 20th China International Forum on Solid State Lighting & 2023 9th International Forum on Wide Bandgap Semiconductors (SSLCHINA: IFWS)
abstract: In this paper, an L-band GaN-based power amplifier on SiC substrate with kilowatt output power is presented. The experimental DC breakdown voltage and maximum output current can reach 250 V and 0.52 A/mm, respectively. Then, we demonstrate a GaN-based HEMT exhibiting a maximum output power of up to 1003W (20.06 W/mm), an operating voltage of up to 100 V, a power-added efficiency (PAE) of 76%, and an associated power gain of 17.1 dB at 1.3 GHz. It was experimentally found that the DC drain current components from the output power all fall on the same curve independent of operation drain voltages. Finally, a theoretical discussion of the influence of the DC drain current component on the output power is briefly given.

articleTitle: CdSe/CdS/SiO2/BN Quantum Rods Assembly for LED Display Application
publicationTitle: 2023 20th China International Forum on Solid State Lighting & 2023 9th International Forum on Wide Bandgap Semiconductors (SSLCHINA: IFWS)
abstract: Semiconductor CdSe/CdS quantum rod (QRs) have attracted great research interest owning to their excellent photoluminescent property, large Stokes shift, and easy integration with mini/micro-LEDs for application in wide- color gamut display devices. However, the CdSe/CdS QRs still face critical stability issue in practical environment. Here, we reported the fabrication of CdSe/CdS/SiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>/BN QRs assembly (QRAs) by encapsulating CdSe/CdS QRs with SiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> and further embedded in layer-by-layer assembled BN nanoplates. The assembly structure effectively improves the heat transfer and air resistance of the QRs in LED devices. The effect of morphology as well as SiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> thickness on the optical performance, fluorescent quenching, and stability of the QRs in LEDs was investigated with optical analysis and thermal simulation. The QRAs converted LEDs demonstrate excellent color quality with largely improved efficiency and long-term stability.

articleTitle: Preparation of Ultra-Small 5 μm Blue InGaN Micro-Light-Emitting Diodes
publicationTitle: 2023 20th China International Forum on Solid State Lighting & 2023 9th International Forum on Wide Bandgap Semiconductors (SSLCHINA: IFWS)
abstract: With the increasing popularity of augmented and virtual reality systems, micro light-emitting diodes (μLEDs) have emerged as a key area of research. The preparation process for ultra-small-size μLEDs is still underdeveloping and hinders the industrialization of μLEDs microdisplay technology. Based on conventional contact ultraviolet lithography, a study was conducted on the fabrication process of ultra-small μLEDs. A 5 μm mesa structure was defined using a two-step photoresist -silicon dioxide etching scheme, and the formation process of small-sized mesas was investigated. The coating and stripping scheme for small-sized electrodes were optimized using a bilayer photoresist bonding process to achieve electrode expansion and preparation with small conductor widths. Arrays of 5 × 5 μm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> μLEDs with uniform surface morphology and good optoelectronic properties were then fabricated. This approach provides a practical solution for scaling up sub-10 μm μLEDs for display applications.

articleTitle: Three-port Resonant LED Driver Combined with VPPM Visible Light Communication Modulation Strategy
publicationTitle: 2023 20th China International Forum on Solid State Lighting & 2023 9th International Forum on Wide Bandgap Semiconductors (SSLCHINA: IFWS)
abstract: A three-port LED driver by combining resonant switchedcapacitor (RSC) circuit unit is proposed. Combined with the proposed driver, a control strategy incorporating Variable Pulse Position Modulation (VPPM) visible light communication modulation with power conversion LED driver is proposed, which the position of the output pulse current is utilized to realize data transmission, and the brightness adjustment required for communication is completed by adjusting the width of the output pulse current, and the output average current can be controlled to be constant. The computer simulation have been carried out. An experimental prototype of the proposed driver and its hybrid control strategy with a rated output of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$0.6{\mathrm{A}}/20{\mathrm{W}}$</tex> is designed and set up. The simulation and experimental results have been obtained to verify the proposed three-port LED driver and its hybrid control strategy.

articleTitle: Neuromorphic Functions in GaN MOSFET
publicationTitle: 2023 20th China International Forum on Solid State Lighting & 2023 9th International Forum on Wide Bandgap Semiconductors (SSLCHINA: IFWS)
abstract: Artificial intelligence system has developed rapidly in recent years and the key to implement brain-like computing is to find a device which can mimic the biological synapse. In this paper we have propose a novel light-stimulated synaptic transistor using GaN MOSFET structure. The basic synaptic functions like excitatory post synaptic current (EPSC), paired- pulse facilitation (PPF), and short-term memory (STM) have been mimicked. The proposed light-stimulated GaN-based synaptic transistor demonstrates a new implementation method for future artificial intelligence system.

articleTitle: Low to Medium Dose Room and Elevated Temperature Implants in 4H-SiC Devices
publicationTitle: 2023 20th China International Forum on Solid State Lighting & 2023 9th International Forum on Wide Bandgap Semiconductors (SSLCHINA: IFWS)
abstract: Effects of aluminum (Al) and nitrogen (N) implantation performed at room and at elevated (500℃) temperatures on epitaxial n-type 4H-SiC have been investigated. Secondary Ion Mass Spectrometry (SIMS) measurements were performed in order to quantify the effect of the implanted ions. Atomic force microscope(AFM) measurements were used to investigate the surface damage. And MOSFETs with different structures were prepared to analyze whether implantation temperature affects device performance. It is found that there is no significant difference in the distribution of Al ions implantation while the depth of N ions implanted at room temperature is evident shallower than that at high temperature. The defects caused by ions implantation are more serious at room temperature, so much so that C atoms are precipitated and Si atoms are deposited and crystallized again during high temperature annealing. The performance of MOSFET devices is in good condition regardless of the implanted temperature except for the difference in values of the a threshold voltage(Vth) and on-resistance(Rdson).

articleTitle: Design of High-Performance Temperature Sensor Based on Planar 4H-SiC Junction Barrier Schottky Diode
publicationTitle: 2023 20th China International Forum on Solid State Lighting & 2023 9th International Forum on Wide Bandgap Semiconductors (SSLCHINA: IFWS)
abstract: In this work, a differential temperature sensor based on 4HSiC lateral Junction Barrier Schottky diodes (LJBS) has been designed for high operating temperature range of 293K-573K. The device parameters have been optimized to achieve high sensitivity and linearity of the temperature sensor. The impact of the device parameters on the sensor's performance has been analyzed. Finally, the performance of the temperature sensor has been evaluated. A high sensitivity of 5.78 mV/K and linearity of 0.998 have been achieved for a bias current of ID=0.4mA and a device ratio of 40

articleTitle: Structure Analysis on the Short-Circuit Robustness for 1200V Planar SiC MOSFETs
publicationTitle: 2023 20th China International Forum on Solid State Lighting & 2023 9th International Forum on Wide Bandgap Semiconductors (SSLCHINA: IFWS)
abstract: Due to the material characteristics of silicon carbide (SiC), the SiC MOSFET robustness under extreme conditions is attractive for further investigation, especially under short circuit conditions. In this paper, 1200V planar SiC MOSFET devices were selected and investigated under TCAD simulation, focusing on the effect of P-base, P+region depth on the short- circuit robustness and analysis of failure mechanisms. First, short-circuit principle was reviewed, followed by the actual short circuit test set-up in the laboratory. Then, we build the current mainstream planar SiC MOSFET device model in TCAD, together with the short circuit simulation circuit according to the laboratory set-up. Finally, it was studied that the influence of the size of P-base region, P+region on the short-circuit performance of the device and concluded the common failure mechanism The work researched the influence of P-base and P+region design parameter influence on the short-circuit performance of planar MOSFET devices, so as to better assist the design for better robustness of SiC power MOSFETs.

articleTitle: Comparison of Random and Channeled Implants of Al Ion into 4H-SiC (0001)
publicationTitle: 2023 20th China International Forum on Solid State Lighting & 2023 9th International Forum on Wide Bandgap Semiconductors (SSLCHINA: IFWS)
abstract: Ion implantation is a well-established technique for introduction of dopants into 4H-SiC. And a strong channeling effect is observed for the ions of Al-ions implanted due to its crystalline structure. Random and channeled implants of Al- ions into the 4H-SiC have been performed in this paper. The depth distribution of Al-ions by implanting in the [000 <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\overline 1 $</tex>] direction is shown to be about 3.0 to 3.5 times deeper than for random implantations that in the wafer miscut angle of 4° direction. And a larger degree of dechanneling is present which implanted at elevated (500°C) temperatures due to increased thermal vibrations and the penetration depth of Al is reduced. There is a large change in peak concentration with increasing Al-ions dose, while the trailing produced by channeling effect is little increased. Atomic force microscopy (AFM) measurements show that the roughness of channeled implants is lower than that of random implants at any energy, Means the corresponding reduction of defect concentrations of channeled implants. These results have important technical implications for the further development of implantation techniques for the fabrication of 4H-SiC devices.

articleTitle: Influence of Upper Channel Thickness on InAlN/GaN/InAlN/GaN Double Channel HEMT
publicationTitle: 2023 20th China International Forum on Solid State Lighting & 2023 9th International Forum on Wide Bandgap Semiconductors (SSLCHINA: IFWS)
abstract: HEMTs featuring a double heterostructure (DC-HEMTs) hold considerable promise for diverse applications, owing to their exceptional output characteristics. In this work, the influence of upper channel thickness on carrier distribution and the DC and RF characteristics of the DC-HEMTs was investigated. As the upper channel thickness decreases gradually, the 2-DEG density in the upper channel decreases, while it increases in the lower channel. These result in corresponding variations in transconductance peaks, f<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">T</inf>, and f<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">max</inf>. Furthermore, the varying effects of drain voltage on carrier concentration in both the upper and lower channels, introduce a novel dimension to the understanding of DC-HEMT characteristics. The observed trends offer crucial considerations for optimizing the design and performance of DC-HEMTs across various applications.

articleTitle: Simulation of Epitaxial Growth of Silicon Carbide in a Horizontal Hot-wall CVD Reaction Chamber
publicationTitle: 2023 20th China International Forum on Solid State Lighting & 2023 9th International Forum on Wide Bandgap Semiconductors (SSLCHINA: IFWS)
abstract: The silicon carbide (SiC) epitaxial growth process is crucial in chip manufacturing. The growth rate and uniformity of epitaxial film are two critical evaluation criteria of epitaxial process. In order to obtain a higher growth rate and more uniform epitaxial film, it is necessary to improve the SiC epitaxial growth process. The traditional method to improve the epitaxial growth process is the “trial and error method”, but this method will consume a lot of time and economic costs. Therefore, it is necessary to find an efficient way to simulate the epitaxial growth process of SiC. This work uses computer aided Multiphysics simulation method to study the growth of SiC epitaxial films in a horizontal hot-wall chemical vapor deposition (CVD) reaction chamber. Firstly, a three-dimensional model of a horizontal hot-wall CVD reaction chamber is established, in which the MTS (methyltrichlorosilane)/H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> is used to deposit SiC epitaxial films on large-area substrates. The effects of temperature, gas flow distribution ratio, and pallet speed on the growth rate and uniformity of SiC epitaxial films are studied. The results show that: 1) In the range of 1500K-1600K, the higher temperature brings the higher growth rate of SiC epitaxial film. 2) The gas flow ratio of three groups of air inlets can simultaneously affect the growth rate and uniformity of the SiC epitaxial film. With the greater the airflow at the middle air inlet, the higher growth rate and the lower film uniformity will be obtained. 3) The tray rotation speed does not affect the film growth rate, but the higher of film uniformity will be achieved under the higher tray rotation speed. The simulation results agree well with the experimental results, which proves that the Multiphysics simulation method is feasible and can be used for further optimization of the epitaxial growth process of SiC.

articleTitle: High Saturation Current HEMTs with ε-Ga2O3/m-GaN Heterojunctions Towards a Potential Candidate for Radio Frequency Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 20th China International Forum on Solid State Lighting & 2023 9th International Forum on Wide Bandgap Semiconductors (SSLCHINA: IFWS)
abstract: These works report ε-Ga<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>/m-face GaN heterojunction based high electron mobility transistors (HEMTs) adopted a T-shape structure for applications in high frequency device for the first time by simulation study.
